title: Marketing Technology Engineer
description:
Build a Safer World.

TRM Labs provides AI-powered intelligence solutions that help public and private sector agencies investigate and disrupt crime. TRM's platforms enable investigators to trace illicit activity, build cases, and construct operating pictures of threat networks. Leading agencies and businesses worldwide rely on TRM to make the world safer and more secure.

Marketing Operations owns the systems the marketing organization runs on: the MarTech stack, the data that describes our funnel, and increasingly the AI agents that do the work. The Marketing Technology Engineer owns the automation and AI layer of that stack — building the agents and automations that remove manual work from the team, and making sure they keep running and keep producing output we can trust. This is a technical role inside a marketing function, and the marketing half is not optional.

The impact you'll have here:

  • Own the operating layer for marketing's agent fleet end to end — provisioning, output verification, monitoring, alerting, and incident response. Nothing counts as shipped until it has run for real and its output has been checked.

  • Design and build agentic processes, skills, and automations that remove manual work from the team, and decide — with marketing judgment — which are worth building at all.

  • Instrument what we build so usage, output, and value are visible to leadership, and so agents improve from feedback rather than staying frozen at launch.

  • Consolidate how core marketing concepts are defined across tools and agents — territory, lead scoring stages, MQL and MQA, pipeline stages, targets — so automations and dashboards cannot quietly disagree, including across two product lines.

  • Own the MarTech stack — configuration, administration, and integration — and build in a way the campaign execution team can extend without engineering support for routine work.

What we're looking for:

  • Prior marketing or marketing operations experience — required, not preferred. You already understand funnel and attribution logic, lead scoring, send-cadence and deliverability norms, and list hygiene and consent rules. This role has no downstream reviewer for marketing correctness.

  • You have personally operated something unattended. A pipeline, integration, or agent that ran on its own, broke without telling you, and taught you to verify output rather than trust a green status. Scale matters less than the scar tissue.

  • A track record of building production automation inside a GTM function — Clay, Zapier, Workato, n8n, or similar — where what you built was depended on by other people and you were the one who owned it.

  • Evidence you have moved from no-code stitching into code and repository practice: version control, code review, CI, testing, and deploying into a shared repo rather than a personal account.

  • Technical baseline: working proficiency in SQL and Python, solid REST API fundamentals, familiarity with secrets management for credentials and API keys, enough data-warehouse fluency (for example BigQuery) to query and reason about data models, and hands-on administration of HubSpot and Salesforce.

Nice to have:

  • Direct experience with Claude, or with n8n.

  • Experience building multi-step enrichment waterfalls in Clay or similar that others depend on.

  • Exposure to observability or data-quality practices — monitoring, alerting, freshness and anomaly checks — in any prior role.

  • Experience supporting more than one product line, where the same metric has to be correct in two motions at once.

About the Team:

  • Marketing Operations is a distributed, not distant team that owns the systems the marketing organization runs on.

  • The work is intellectually difficult because the same metric has to stay correct across two product lines and multiple tools and agents at once.

  • Ownership is high: this role makes consequential marketing decisions without a downstream reviewer.

The following represents the expected range of compensation for this role:

  • Individual pay is determined by skills, qualifications, experience, and location. The compensation details listed in this posting reflect the US base salary only.

  • The estimated base salary range for this role is $150,000–$190,000 USD.

  • Additionally, this role may be eligible to participate in TRM’s equity plan.

  • Please note – we factor in the different costs for geographies outside the United States

Application Instructions

If you’re interested in joining TRM, we encourage you to apply directly. Every application is reviewed by our Talent team.

Before applying, review the job description carefully and highlight the experience and impact that best demonstrate the required qualifications. Please also provide thoughtful and accurate answers to the application questions, as these will be used to evaluate your skills and qualifications for the role.

If you send your resume directly to someone at TRM, we can’t guarantee it will reach the appropriate hiring team. Applying directly is the best way to ensure your application will be considered.

Interviewing with TRM

Our process is designed to understand how you think, solve problems, and deliver impact, while allowing you to evaluate TRM. Most interview processes include a case study, an AI skills assessment, and a Leadership Principles interview.

  • Recruiter Intro: Qualifications, motivations, and alignment with the role.

  • Hiring Manager: Deep dive into your relevant experience, skills, and impact.

  • First Round: 1–2 interviews focused on the skills most critical to the role.

  • Final Round: Hands-on case study. This is usually a panel-style session where we go deeper into your craft, problem-solving, and alignment with TRM.

  • References: Former colleagues who can provide insight into your work and impact.

  • Offer: Congrats! Your recruiter will present the offer and compensation details.

  • Welcome to TRM: We're excited to build a safer world with you!

Your recruiter will share your specific interview plan and preparation guidance along the way.

AI Fluency at TRM

AI fluency is a baseline expectation at TRM.

We believe AI meaningfully changes how top performers operate. We expect every team member to use AI to accelerate and reimagine their craft, not just automate surface tasks.

At TRM, AI fluency means you are among the top 10 percent of operators in your function in how you apply AI to:

  • Accelerate repeatable workflows

  • Structure and solve problems

  • Improve output quality

  • Increase speed and leverage

You will be evaluated on applied AI fluency during the interview process.

Life at TRM

We are building a safer world. That promise shows up in how we work every day.

TRM moves FAST. We are a high-velocity, high-ownership team that expects clarity, follow-through, and impact. People who thrive here are energized by hard problems, experimentation, and continuous feedback. If something takes months elsewhere, it will ship here in days.

Our work sits at the intersection of AI, national security, and fighting crime. The problems are complex, the stakes are real, and the environment evolves quickly. The pace and intensity of the work reflect the importance of the mission. As a result, the way we operate requires a high level of ownership, adaptability, collaboration, and creative problem-solving.

At TRM, you should expect:

  • Priorities and targets to change quickly

  • Operating with a high degree of ambiguity

  • A high level of personal ownership and accountability

  • Close collaboration across teams and functions

  • Frequent, high-touch communication

  • Creative problem-solving and out-of-the-box thinking

  • A pace that rewards urgency, adaptability, and outcomes

This environment is energizing for people who enjoy building, solving hard problems, and making progress in situations that are not always fully defined. It also requires thriving in ambiguity, adjusting course as new information emerges, and maintaining focus and positivity in a fast-moving and intense environment.

We also recognize that this style of operating is not for everyone. If you are primarily optimizing for predictability or a consistently balanced workload, we encourage you to use the interview process to pressure-test whether this environment is truly the right fit. We want teammates who thrive here, not just survive here.

If you are excited by meaningful problems, motivated by ambitious goals, and energized by working alongside mission-driven colleagues, there is a good chance you will find TRM to be an exceptional place to grow and contribute.

Leadership Principles

We hire and grow against three leadership principles. They’re the standards for how we operate, treat each other, and make decisions.

  • Impact-Oriented Trailblazer: We put customers first and move with speed, focus, and adaptability. We treat every plan like an experiment – test, ship, measure, and iterate quickly.

  • Master Craftsperson: We care deeply about our craft. We balance speed with high standards, own outcomes end‑to‑end, and invest in getting better everyday.

  • Inspiring Colleague: We add clarity and energy, not noise. We bring humility, candor, and a one‑team mindset — giving and receiving feedback to make the team stronger.

Join our Mission

At TRM, we care deeply about our craft. We are looking for individuals who want their work to matter, who experiment with speed and rigor, and who take pride in building a safer world for billions of people. If you’re excited by TRM’s mission but don’t check every box, we encourage you to apply — we hire for slope, judgment, and the will to learn fast.

TRM is a Series C company with $220M in total funding, backed by Goldman Sachs, Bessemer, Y Combinator, Thoma Bravo, and others. Headquartered in San Francisco, TRM operates as a distributed-first company with hubs in Los Angeles, San Francisco, New York, Washington D.C., London, and Singapore.

Privacy Policy and Additional Information

By submitting your application, you agree to allow TRM Labs to process your personal information in accordance with our Privacy Policy.

We collect the information you provide (such as your resume, work history, and contact details) solely for the purpose of evaluating your candidacy for current and future roles at TRM.

Because our hiring cycles for certain positions may span 24 to 36 months, we retain your personal information for up to 36 months from the date of your application. After that period, your data is deleted unless a different retention period is required or permitted by law.

If you are located in the European Economic Area, the United Kingdom, or another jurisdiction with applicable data protection laws, you have the right to access, correct, or request deletion of your personal data at any time before that period ends. To exercise any of these rights, contact us at privacy@trmlabs.com.

To notify TRM Labs that you believe this job posting is non-compliant, please submit a report through this form. No response will be provided to inquiries unrelated to job posting compliance.

The use of AI tools of any kind (including but not limited to notetakers, interview assistants, and real-time coaching tools such as Otter.ai, Fireflies, Fathom, Cluey, or similar) during TRM interviews is not permitted without prior approval from TRM. TRM uses its own internal tools for note-taking to ensure a consistent and confidential experience for all candidates.

We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations to applicants with disabilities, and requests can be made via this form.

Recruitment agencies

TRM Labs does not accept unsolicited agency resumes. Please do not forward resumes to TRM employees. TRM Labs is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes and will not pay fees to any third-party agency or company without a signed agreement.

title: Security Engineer, IAM
description:
Role Description

Security Engineers at Dropbox safeguard our digital ecosystem alongside a diverse team of professionals dedicated to protecting our products and users. Trusted by millions, our mission is to integrate security seamlessly into Dropbox, empowering confident collaboration.

In this role, you’ll build and operate the identity and access controls that help Dropbox employees, services, and AI agents access what they need securely. You’ll combine security engineering and automation to strengthen authentication and authorization, enforce least privilege, and simplify identity lifecycle management across our infrastructure. Working closely with Infrastructure, Corp Engineering, Developer Platform, and Incident Response, you’ll make secure access easier to use and maintain reliable IAM services as Dropbox adopts new AI tools and agentic workflows.

Our Engineering Career Framework is viewable by anyone outside the company and describes what’s expected for our engineers at each of our career levels. Check out our blog post on this topic and more here.

Responsibilities

  • Design, deploy, and operate IAM controls across Dropbox’s cloud and on-premises infrastructure
  • Design and implement secure identity, authentication, and authorization controls for AI agents and other non-human actors
  • Implement least-privilege access using RBAC, ABAC, permission boundaries, service control policies, and just-in-time access
  • Design secure integrations using SAML, OAuth 2.1, OpenID Connect, SCIM, and SPIFFE/SPIRE
  • Automate identity lifecycle processes to ensure access is granted, modified, and revoked promptly
  • Develop identity guardrails using infrastructure-as-code and policy-as-code
  • Build monitoring and alerting for anomalous authentication, privilege escalation, credential misuse, and unauthorized access
  • Partner with Incident Response to investigate identity-related incidents and rapidly revoke compromised access
  • Conduct security reviews and threat modeling for new identity architectures and integrations
  • Maintain IAM services with strong reliability, documentation, operational ownership, and on-call support

Many teams at Dropbox run Services with on-call rotations, which entails being available for calls during both core and non-core business hours. If a team has an on-call rotation, all engineers on the team are expected to participate in the rotation as part of their employment. Applicants are encouraged to ask for more details of the rotations to which the applicant is applying.

Requirements

  • 5+ years of security engineering experience, including substantial IAM or identity-security experience
  • Hands-on experience with Okta, Okta for AI Agents and Sailpoint, or comparable technologies
  • Strong understanding of authentication, authorization, least privilege, zero trust, and identity lifecycle management
  • Experience with SAML, OAuth 2.0/2.1, OpenID Connect, SCIM, and MFA
  • Experience designing RBAC or ABAC authorization models
  • Experience securing human and non-human identities, including services, workloads, automation, and CI/CD systems
  • Experience with agentic frameworks and MCP tool integration
  • Experience implementing access reviews, privileged-access controls, and joiner/mover/leaver workflows
  • Proficiency in at least one programming or scripting language, such as Python, Go, Java, Ruby, or Bash
  • Experience with infrastructure-as-code, policy-as-code, APIs, and security automation
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Security, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with workload identity technologies such as SPIFFE/SPIRE, Kubernetes service accounts, or cloud workload identity.
  • Experience securing identities and authorization for AI agents and other autonomous systems.
  • Experience with just-in-time access, zero-standing-privilege, or privileged-access management platforms.
  • Familiarity with identity threat detection and response.
  • Experience building IAM controls for multi-account cloud environments.
  • Familiarity with NIST SP 800-63, NIST SP 800-207, CIS benchmarks, and relevant identity-security guidance.
  • Experience supporting compliance programs such as SOC 2, ISO 27001, or FedRAMP.
  • Security certifications such as CISSP, CCSP, or equivalent.
  • Contributions to the identity or security community through open-source projects, publications, or conferences.

Durable Skills

AI fluency means using these tools to amplify human judgment, not replace it. We believe people with these skills will thrive as work and technology continue to evolve:

  • Awareness: Understand yourself and others.
  • Judgment: Evaluate information and make decisions in complex situations.
  • Adaptability: Learn, adjust, and stay effective through change.
  • Connection: Communicate, collaborate, and build trust.

To learn more about why these skills matter and what the data shows about thriving through change, read this blog post from our Chief People Officer, Melanie Rosenwasser.

This role is not available in Zone 1

US Zone 2

$193,500—$261,900 USD

US Zone 3

$172,000—$232,800 USD

title: GTM System Engineer
description:
About Us:

Nivoda: where innovation and gemstones meet

At Nivoda, we help jewellery retailers and gemstone suppliers trade more easily. Our B2B marketplace connects jewellery businesses of all sizes with global diamond and gemstone supply.

Nivoda has more than 400 employees across the world. Our platform helps buyers and sellers trade diamonds and gemstones securely, efficiently and at competitive prices.

The Data & Financial Platform team

The Data & Financial Platform team owns Nivoda's data platform plus the shared financial capabilities of the marketplace. Its job is to make core data and financial systems reliable, useful and scalable.

This role sits in the team but works day to day with GTM. You will work with the Head of Data, engineers, analysts, Sales and Marketing as we rebuild Nivoda's GTM infrastructure.

About the role

Nivoda is rebuilding its GTM infrastructure. Too much of the funnel still relies on manual steps, disconnected tools and fragile hand-offs. This role exists to replace them with reliable systems and automation.

You will work across our platform, GTM Engine, Salesforce, Customer.io, enrichment services, Snowflake and other tools. Salesforce is an important integration point, but you will not own it. Start with the problem, choose the simplest sensible approach, then build or configure what is needed.

This is a hands-on engineering role working closely with the Head of Data and experienced engineers. You will have context and clear priorities, with room to work through the detail, propose an approach and ship it safely.

What would you be doing?

  • Work with GTM stakeholders to turn unclear process requests into clear technical requirements and a sensible implementation approach.

  • Build integrations, customer or prospect event flows, automations and changes to our GTM Engine. Use APIs, webhooks, queues, scheduled workflows or small services where they fit.

  • Choose build, buy or configure based on the problem. Prefer native platform capability first, tooling or middleware second, custom code where it creates real value.

  • Build for production from the start. Test common failure paths, handle duplicates and retries, then add the monitoring needed to spot problems quickly.

  • Ship and support what you build using version control, code review and safe deployment. Help troubleshoot or recover failures after launch.

  • Work with Salesforce, other platform owners and our Commercial Data Analyst to integrate cleanly while making sure systems emit the data needed to measure performance.

  • Document important flows, decisions and recovery steps so the stack does not depend on one person.

What do we need from you?

  • 2+ years in software, systems or integration engineering. You have shipped real integrations or services using APIs, webhooks or event-driven systems.

  • Solid programming ability in Python, JavaScript or TypeScript. Working SQL plus confidence using Git and code review.

  • Experience integrating with business systems such as CRM, payments, finance, marketing or operations platforms. Salesforce experience is useful but not required.

  • You can work directly with non-technical stakeholders. You can challenge an unclear request and turn the underlying need into something buildable.

  • You can learn unfamiliar systems quickly, then choose the simplest solution that will hold up in production.

  • You think about failure cases such as unavailable APIs, duplicate records or conflicting updates before they become production problems.

Nice to have

  • Experience at a marketplace or a company selling to small businesses at volume.

  • Hands-on time with an iPaaS or workflow tool such as n8n, Zapier or Workato.

  • Familiarity with tools in our stack such as Snowflake, Customer.io, Gong, Clay or similar systems.

  • Experience with cloud runtimes, CI/CD, observability or production support.

Our culture and what we offer

  • Flexible working hours and a vibrant company culture

  • Private health insurance

  • Opportunities for growth and learning

  • Flexible compensation card (meals, transport, childcare)

  • Unlimited holiday allowance

  • The chance to join during an exponential expansion phase

Equal opportunity

Nivoda is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. Even if it seems you don't meet 100% of our musts, don't let that stop you: we would still love to hear from you.

Please submit your CV in English.

Not the right role for you right now? Join the Nivoda Talent Pool and we will keep you in mind for future opportunities.

title: Aerodynamics Expert (MSc. or PhD)
description:
Aerodynamics Expert (MSc. or PhD)

Pay: $80–$120/hour

Location: Global, fully remote

Job Type: Contractor (~15 hours per week)

Schedule: Flexible—you can choose the hours and days you work, including weekends if desired

We are looking for a highly skilled Aerodynamics Expert to contribute to an AI training project involving computational fluid dynamics, aerodynamic analysis, engineering simulation, and Python.

The work involves creating, solving, reviewing, and validating engineering tasks that can be completed through programmatic, command-line-based workflows. A representative task may require analyzing an airfoil, preparing a computational domain and mesh, defining appropriate boundary conditions, running a CFD simulation, calculating lift and drag, and determining whether the resulting flow field is numerically and physically valid.

What You’ll Work On

  1. Solve and validate aerodynamic and fluid-dynamics problems.
  2. Translate physical requirements into computational models and solver-ready cases.
  3. Create or modify geometries, computational domains, and meshes.
  4. Define appropriate initial conditions, boundary conditions, fluid properties, and solver settings.
  5. Run CFD and aerodynamic-analysis workflows using command-line-accessible tools.
  6. Use Python to automate preprocessing, simulation execution, parameter sweeps, postprocessing, and validation.

Required Qualifications

  1. An MS or PhD in Aerospace Engineering, or Mechanical Engineering with an aerodynamics, fluid dynamics, or thermofluids specialization; or
  2. A BS in Aerospace or Mechanical Engineering plus at least 1–2 years of aero-specific professional or research experience.
  3. Strong understanding of fluid mechanics and applied aerodynamics.
  4. Experience formulating and executing CFD or aerodynamic analyses.
  5. Practical proficiency with Python.
  6. Experience with at least one engineering tool or library that can be operated through a CLI, scripting interface, configuration files, or programmatic API.
  7. Ability to select and justify modeling assumptions, boundary conditions, mesh strategies, and solver settings.
  8. Ability to diagnose non-convergence, unstable solutions, incorrect results, and physically invalid outputs.
  9. Ability to communicate technical reasoning and engineering trade-offs clearly.

Relevant tools may include Python,OpenFOAM, SU2, Gmsh, FEniCSx, Elmer, CalculiX, SciPy, or similar programmatic engineering software. Experience with an equivalent CLI-accessible tool is acceptable.

Relevant Python tools may include NumPy, SciPy, pandas, Matplotlib, Jupyter, solver APIs, mesh-processing libraries, or domain-specific scientific packages. No single library is mandatory.

Process

  1. Apply to the role and complete the screening questions.
  2. Complete an AI interview of approximately 30 minutes.
  3. Complete the hiring manager review.

Compensation Structure

Compensation is output-based. Experts are paid per task that meets the project specifications. The time required to complete each task may vary depending on the expert’s experience and workflow.

Minimum submission requirements apply.

Start Timeline & Availability

  1. We typically fill roles within 48 hours and are looking for experts who are ready to begin immediately. If selected, you will be expected to start your first task within 24–48 hours of completing onboarding.

title: AI Strategist
description:
Cresta unlocks the true potential of the customer experience, turning every conversation into a competitive advantage. Cresta’s unified AI platform combines conversational AI agents, real-time human agent augmentation, and comprehensive conversation intelligence to drive revenue and efficiency gains across every channel. The world’s leading companies, including United Airlines, Cox Communications, and Marriott, use Cresta to power world-class customer experiences every day.

Born from the Stanford AI Lab, Cresta has raised more than $270 million from the world’s leading investors, including a16z, Greylock, and Sequoia. Cresta’s leadership includes some of the leading minds in AI today. Our CEO, Ping Wu, founded and led Google's Contact Center AI and Vertex AI platforms before joining Cresta to build the future of AI-driven customer experiences.

Over the next few years, AI is going to redefine how people all over the world interact with businesses every day. Come build that future at Cresta.

About the Role:

As an AI Strategist, you are the embedded AI leader for our customers. You connect what customers are saying in their conversations, what their business needs most, and what Cresta's AI can do, then turn that into a prioritized plan and measurable results. You identify where automation and augmentation will deliver the most value, build the roadmap, and make sure the work ships and pays off.

You will not be building AI Agents from scratch. Our Forward Deployed Engineers and Forward Deployed Product Managers create and deploy them. Your focus is on making deployed AI better: finding the next opportunity, optimizing what is already live, piloting new Cresta capabilities, and proving the business impact. You are analytical, commercially minded, and credible with senior stakeholders in CX, Operations, Product, Sales, and IT. You are technical enough to work closely with FDEs and FDPMs and to give product and engineering a tight feedback loop.

What You'll Do:

AI Strategy and Roadmap

  • Identify automation and augmentation opportunities across the customer's contact center and wider customer experience operation.
  • Prioritize initiatives by expected ROI and build a business case for each one.
  • Build and maintain the customer's enterprise AI roadmap, and keep it current as priorities and Cresta capabilities change.
  • Align stakeholders across CX, Operations, Product, Sales, and IT on priorities, sequencing, and success criteria.

Conversation Intelligence and Business Insights

  • Use conversation data to surface customer friction and emerging trends before they show up in other metrics.
  • Identify operational inefficiencies and the changes that would reduce them.
  • Share Voice of Customer insights with customer leadership and with Cresta product teams.
  • Measure business impact and report it in terms executives care about, such as containment, handle time, conversion, CSAT, and cost to serve.

AI Innovation and Execution

  • Stay current on new Cresta features and bring the relevant ones to customers early.
  • Pilot emerging AI capabilities, define how success will be judged, and decide with the customer whether to scale them.
  • Optimize live AI Agents by analyzing performance, reviewing conversations, and recommending changes to prompts, workflows, and configurations.
  • Coordinate deployments with FDEs, FDPMs, and customer teams, including milestones, timelines, and dependencies.
  • Measure realized value after launch and report it back against the original business case.

What We're Looking For:

  • Experience: 5+ years in technology consulting, strategy, product, analytics, implementation, or customer success roles, ideally with AI or LLM-first products.
  • Strategic and commercial skills: A track record of building roadmaps, prioritizing by ROI, and writing business cases that senior stakeholders approve.
  • Analytical approach: Strong data skills. You are comfortable analyzing conversation or operational data, designing experiments such as A/B tests, and monitoring performance to refine solutions.
  • Technical understanding: Working knowledge of how LLM-based AI agents function, including prompts, tools or function calling, and retrieval-augmented generation. Hands-on experience with an agent project, even a personal one, is a plus. You do not need to write production code, but you can read and reason about system behavior and discuss tradeoffs with engineers.
  • Stakeholder leadership: Experience leading cross-functional work and influencing senior customer stakeholders across CX, Operations, Product, Sales, and IT.
  • Communication: Excellent written, verbal, and presentation skills. You can explain a complex finding to an executive in plain language.
  • Execution: Strong project management skills and a bias for action. You turn ambiguity into a plan and follow it through to results.
  • Mindset: Curious, self-driven, and comfortable learning quickly in a fast-moving startup environment. You are passionate about AI, automation, and the future of customer experience.
  • Education: Bachelor's degree in Business, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience.

Bonus Points:

  • Familiarity with customer support and contact center operations, including metrics such as AHT, FCR, containment, and QA
  • Experience with conversation intelligence, speech analytics, or voice-of-customer programs
  • Background in management consulting, product management, or forward deployed roles
  • Experience in a startup or high-growth SaaS environment
  • Comfort with SQL or a BI tool for self-serve analysis

Perks & Benefits:

We offer a comprehensive and people-first benefits package to support you at work and in life:

  • Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage with plans to fit you and your family
  • Flexible PTO to take the time you need, when you need it
  • Paid parental leave for all new parents welcoming a new child
  • Retirement savings plan to help you plan for the future
  • Remote work setup budget to help you create a productive home office
  • Monthly wellness and communication stipend to keep you connected and balanced
  • In-office meal program and commuter benefits provided for onsite employees

Compensation at Cresta:

Cresta's approach to compensation is simple: recognize impact, reward excellence, and invest in our people. We offer competitive, location-based pay that reflects the market and what each individual brings to the table.

The posted compensation range represents what we expect to pay for this role in a given location. Final offers are shaped by factors like experience, skills, education, and geography. In addition to base pay, total compensation includes equity and a comprehensive benefits package for you and your family.

OTE Range: $150,000 to $200,000 + Offers Equity

Our use of AI in recruiting: We may use AI tools in our recruiting process, which require human review and oversight. If you have questions about our use of AI or wish to opt out, please contact recruiting@cresta.ai (if you are opting out, please use the subject ‘Opt-Out’ in your email).

Recording & AI transcription: We do not authorize candidates to record or use AI transcription of any interview by phone, notetaker app, AI glasses, or other device. Candidates may request an exception or accommodation for review during the interview process as needed.

Recruiting impersonation scams: We have noticed a rise in recruiting impersonations across the industry, where scammers attempt to access candidates' personal and financial information through fake interviews and offers. All Cresta recruiting email communications will always come from the @cresta.ai domain. Any outreach claiming to be from Cresta via other sources should be ignored.

title: STEM Expert – Chemistry & Computational Chemistry (PhD)
description:
Role Title: STEM Expert – Chemistry & Computational Chemistry (PhD)

Role Type: Contractor

Location: Remote (Worldwide)

Job Summary: In this role, you’ll apply your expertise to help train next-generation AI systems. Your work will shape how models learn, reason, and perform through high-quality, real-world input.

Key Responsibilities:

  1. Design, evaluate, and critique chemistry and computational chemistry problems, workflows, and reasoning chains to support AI benchmarking initiatives.
  2. Provide expert-level insights on reaction mechanisms, synthesis planning, spectroscopy analysis, molecular simulations, and electronic structure methods.
  3. Assess and optimize experimental protocols, simulation parameters, and software configurations for accuracy and reproducibility.
  4. Analyze chemical, spectroscopic, and simulation data and provide actionable recommendations.
  5. Leverage domain knowledge to guide the development and validation of chemistry-related AI models and tools.
  6. Communicate complex scientific concepts clearly, both in writing and verbally, to technical and non-technical collaborators.
  7. Document findings, methodologies, and best practices to ensure knowledge transfer across the customer’s team.

Areas of Expertise (we welcome applicants from any of the following):

  1. Organic synthesis & reaction mechanisms
  2. Inorganic & organometallic chemistry
  3. Physical & theoretical chemistry
  4. Analytical chemistry & spectroscopy
  5. Computational chemistry & molecular dynamics
  6. Cheminformatics & drug discovery
  7. Materials science & polymer chemistry

Required Skills and Qualifications:

  1. PhD in chemistry, computational chemistry, chemical biology, materials science, or a closely related field.
  2. Hands-on research lab experience, including wet lab experience for experimental subfields, or extensive simulation-heavy research for computational subfields.
  3. Deep expertise in at least one of the areas listed above.
  4. Professional written and spoken English (C1 or higher).
  5. Proficiency in Python and/or industry-standard tools in your subfield (e.g., Gaussian, ORCA, Psi4, GROMACS, LAMMPS, RDKit).
  6. Excellent quantitative, analytical, and scientific reasoning skills.
  7. Outstanding written and verbal communication abilities, with the ability to clearly document and explain technical concepts.
  8. Track record of rigorous scientific problem-solving in complex chemistry domains.

Preferred Qualifications:

  1. Academic experience (postdoc, research scientist, faculty, or equivalent), strongly preferred.
  2. Peer-reviewed publications, patents, or contributions to open-source scientific software.
  3. Experience with AI/ML-assisted chemistry workflows or benchmarking.
  4. Background in drug discovery, reaction prediction, or retrosynthesis.

Partnering with development, product, and support teams, you will raise engineering standards, embed a quality-first culture, and ensure seamless delivery across the software lifecycle. In this fully remote role, you will lead the evolution of our quality practices through modern automation and AI-driven testing, with the autonomy to experiment, innovate, and transform how we validate platform performance, complex business logic, and emerging AI capabilities.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and maintain scalable test automation frameworks for distributed cloud platforms.

  • Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams in technical design discussions, code reviews, and continuous improvement initiatives.

  • Establish, track, and analyze meaningful quality metrics to optimize platform reliability, test coverage, and execution speed.

  • Explore and implement AI-powered testing tools to enhance test generation, maintenance, and defect analysis.

title: US Remote Patient Care Advocate (Customer Service)
description:
Job Title: Patient Care Advocate 

Job Location: Remote


About Us: 

We are a dedicated team focused on improving access to affordable prescription medications for patients. By partnering with insurance companies, healthcare providers, and pharmacies, we work to reduce the financial burden of medications, ensuring that patients can access the treatments they need without excessive costs. 


Role Overview: 

As a key member of our team, you will help patients navigate our Prescription Payment Plan. This involves working closely with patients, insurance providers, healthcare professionals, and pharmacies to ensure seamless enrollment, eligibility verification, cost-sharing, and prescription fulfillment. 


What You’ll Do: 

  • Patient Enrollment & Eligibility: Assist patients with enrolling in the program, ensuring all necessary personal and insurance information is provided and verifying eligibility. 
  • Prescription Coverage: Help patients confirm that their prescribed medications are covered under the program, and manage the approval process for eligible medications. 
  • Cost-Sharing & Payment: Reduce patients' out-of-pocket costs by applying the program benefits. Manage copayments, coinsurance, and assist with additional copay assistance when applicable. 
  • Prescription Fulfillment: Coordinate with participating pharmacies to ensure the correct application of benefits during prescription filling, ensuring patients pay the reduced amount. 
  • Refills & Continued Use: Support patients by ensuring they continue receiving medications at reduced costs, monitoring adherence to medication regimens, and ensuring continued eligibility. 
  • Program Renewal & Updates: Guide patients through annual renewals and inform them about any updates to the program or medication formulary. 


What We’re Looking For: 

  • High school diploma or GED required
  • Experience in healthcare, insurance or customer service required (experience with prescription assistance programs is a plus)
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to navigate complex processes
  • Excellent communication skills for working with patients, healthcare providers, and pharmacies
  • A genuine passion for helping others and making a positive impact on their healthcare access
  • The ability to work efficiently and collaboratively within a team environment

Success Factors for Working from Home 

  • Private Workspace: A dedicated, quiet workspace with a door that closes, free from ambient noise. 
  • Ergonomics: A comfortable desk and chair setup that allows for the proper installation of necessary equipment. 
  • Reliable Internet Connection: Stable, high-speed internet with a minimum bandwidth of 10 Mbps downstream and 5 Mbps upstream. 
  • Quiet, Distraction-Free Workspace: A dedicated, quiet area where you can focus on delivering excellent customer service without interruptions. 
  • Tech-Savvy: Comfort with technology and ability to learn new systems quickly. 
  • Self-motivation & Independence: Ability to stay productive and manage your time effectively in a remote environment. 
  • Communication Skills: Strong verbal and written communication skills, especially in a virtual setting. 
  • Adaptability: Ability to adapt to changing technologies and procedures while working remotely. 


Compensation & Perks 

  • Hourly Pay: $16.50 per hour 
  • Company-Provided Equipment: All necessary equipment will be provided. 
  • Comprehensive Benefits: Full health insurance package including medical, dental, and vision coverage. 
  • Cell Phone Benefits: $25/month per line for unlimited phone, text, and data (restrictions may apply). 
  • Generous Referral Program: Earn $50 per paycheck for every person you refer—and your referral earns it too! No limits on payouts. 
  • Comprehensive Training: Paid training to ensure you are fully prepared for success. 
  • Career Growth: Opportunities for career advancement and professional development within a leading healthcare provider. 
  • Work-from-Home Convenience: Save time, and money, and reduce your environmental footprint. 
  • Inclusive Culture: We are an Equal Opportunity Employer, including individuals with disabilities and veterans. 

What Success Looks Like: 

  • Reduced out-of-pocket costs for patients through effective cost-sharing and copay assistance 
  • Timely and accurate processing of prescription claims and approvals 
  • High patient satisfaction with the program’s support and streamlined experience 
  • Compliance with program requirements and monitoring of patient eligibility for ongoing assistance 

Why Join Us? 

  • Be part of a team that makes a real difference in patients' lives by reducing the cost of necessary medications 
  • Opportunity for professional growth in the healthcare and insurance sectors 
  • Competitive compensation and benefits package 
  • A collaborative, supportive, and innovative work culture 

Ready to Make an Impact? 

Join us in making prescription medications more affordable and accessible for those who need them most. If you're ready to help make a difference, we'd love to hear from you! 

If you like wild growth and working with happy, enthusiastic over-achievers, you'll enjoy your career with us!

title: Solutions Engineer
description:
Consequential Work. Dedicated People.


About Onebrief

Onebrief builds collaboration and AI-powered workflow software for military planning and operational coordination.

Military planning is complex by nature, requiring teams to coordinate information, people, and decisions across systems and locations. Onebrief brings planning, collaboration, simulation, and AI into one connected environment, helping teams test strategies, adapt to changing conditions, and make decisions with greater clarity when the stakes are real.

We are a distributed team of builders from military, operational, and technology backgrounds who care deeply about improving how important work gets done. Some team members work remotely, while others work directly alongside customers in operational environments around the world.

Founded in 2019, Onebrief is backed by leading investors including General Catalyst, Battery Ventures, Insight Partners, Sapphire Ventures, and Human Capital. Valued at more than $2 billion, we continue to invest in product innovation, AI capabilities, and team growth.

Why This Role Exists

As a Solutions Engineer at Onebrief, you work where mission, engineering, and compliance meet.

You'll own technical solution design and deployment readiness, translating customer requirements into secure, scalable deployment architectures. You'll partner with Platform Engineering, SRE, and our Cybersecurity team to validate infrastructure, configure environments, resolve technical blockers, and successfully transition solutions into production.

Youâll work with our go-to-market and customer facing teams to meet with planners, operations officers, and network owners to understand how they work today. Youâll help show them what that work looks like in Onebrief, and then you'll make it real.

You connect a staff's planning problem to a live, accredited Onebrief deployment.

What You'll Do

Core responsibilities:

  • Run technical discovery. With Sales and Engineering, map a staff's current workflow and pain points, specifically focusing on their technical constraints: networks, hosting, identity, and integration requirements, especially in multi-network environments.

  • Lead deployment engineering. Coordinate the technical delivery of new deployments, including infrastructure validation, network configuration checks, and system readiness verification. Write code to configure new deployments and support new environments.

  • Support accreditation. Help create and review security documentation, including STIG checklists and ATO artifacts, alongside our cybersecurity team so deployments are accredited on the customer's timeline.

  • Align stakeholders. Get technical stakeholders on both sides to agree on requirements, constraints, and tradeoffs, so customers see value sooner. Ensure those technical requirements are properly translated into contract deliverables.

  • Scope integrations. Design how Onebrief Connect fits into a command's ecosystem: APIs, data pipelines, Foundry and Maven Smart System, CUOPS tools, and dashboards.

title: Junior Software Developer - Python & Web Applications (m/f/d)
description:
At Statista, we’re all about facts and data, for we are the world's leading business data platform. By providing reliable and easy-to-use data as well as various data analytics products and services, we empower people worldwide to make fact-based decisions.

Founded in Hamburg in 2007, we have quickly grown into a global company with offices in major cities such as London, New York, Berlin and Tokyo. And we still have a lot of plans. Our constant growth does not only prove our success, but also keeps creating new development and career opportunities for our employees.

We value and celebrate our diverse culture. You are welcome here for who you are, no matter where you come from, what you look like, or whether you prefer bar graphs to pie charts. Your story matters – keep writing it as part of our team.

Are you ready to join us?

Your team
This job is with Statista R, a vertical business unit of Statista.

Statista R is a world leader in the creation of company, brand, and product rankings and top lists, based on comprehensive market research and data analysis: Statista R recognizes the best.

With a team of over 100 expert analysts and in cooperation with more than 40 high profile media brands across all continents like Forbes, TIME Magazine and Newsweek, Statista R creates transparency for consumers and business decision makers and helps companies build trust and recognition across a plethora of industries and product categories. A team of over 50 licensing specialists based in New York, Hamburg, Tokyo, and Singapore offers the awarded companies meaningful and eye-catching opportunities to communicate their success via logos and other award related products. Visit rankings.statista.com for further information about Statista R and our rankings.

Your Role

  • Design, build and maintain web applications for working with data as a core part of your role, mainly using Python frameworks such as Django and Streamlit

  • Work closely with our senior Data Engineer and other experienced data professionals who build our analytics products and pipelines, learn hands-on about our AWS cloud environment and ETL processes, and help build reliable data pipelines and PostgreSQL queries

  • Prepare, transform and validate data so our applications and analyses rest on a solid foundation

  • Create visualizations and insight reports that make findings clear and actionable, both to make our analyst team's processes more efficient and to produce strong client-facing materials

  • Work with teammates to turn analytical questions into usable features and workflows, and develop repeatable ways to build expertise and value for our stakeholders

  • Support projects based on large-scale, survey-based market research data, and help develop methods that complement our existing ranking products

Your Profile

  • Solid hands-on skills in Python, gained through professional work, internships, research, or your own projects. Experience coding in R is advantageous

  • Experience building web applications with Django and/or Streamlit is a strong plus. Knowledge of PostgreSQL or another SQL database, and basic HTML, CSS or JavaScript, is also a plus

  • A basic understanding of cloud environments such as AWS and of ETL concepts, and the motivation to grow these skills alongside experienced colleagues

  • Hands-on experience working with data, including querying, cleaning, analyzing, visualizing and checking data quality

  • Clean coding habits that make teamwork easy, such as readable code and basic Git workflows

  • Enjoyment in building tools other people use, a collaborative way of working, and the curiosity to dig into unfamiliar problems

What we offer

In addition to our great team, culture, and our shared goal of empowering people with data, there are many other things that make Statista a great place to work! Join us and benefit from:

  • Work from abroad up to 30 calendar days a year

  • Hybrid work and flex-time

  • International team and social events

  • Subsidized urban mobility and access to fitness and wellness options

  • Free access to Langdock and all its amazing functionalities

  • Career & training opportunities

  • Attractive locations and modern offices

  • Mental health support with OpenUp

Some of the benefits listed here apply only to the German entity and to Junior-level roles or above.

title: Solution Architect & TechLead (w/m/d) - 3D-SaaS und AWS
description:
Wir suchen Dich!

Als Solution Architect & Tech Lead (m/w/d) gestaltest Du die Architektur unserer 3D-SaaS-Plattform InfraCloud und entwickelst Lösungen für die digitale Inspektion und das Asset-Management von Bauwerken. Du übersetzt Produktanforderungen in technische Konzepte, leitest das Entwicklungsteam fachlich und bringst Dich auch selbst in die Softwareentwicklung ein.

Verstärke unser Team in Vollzeit an unserem Standort in Hamburg oder arbeite remote innerhalb Deutschlands. Die Position ist unbefristet; Deine Arbeitszeit gestaltest Du flexibel innerhalb eines Kollaborationsfensters von 8:00 bis 19:00 Uhr deutscher Zeit.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Du verantwortest die Solution-Architektur von InfraCloud und übersetzt Produktanforderungen in technische Designs, Datenmodelle, API-Verträge und Integrationskonzepte.

  • Du entwickelst rund 30–40 % Deiner Arbeitszeit selbst Prototypen und kritische Komponenten, behebst bei Bedarf Produktionsprobleme und treibst Testautomatisierung sowie technische Qualität voran.

Dein Profil

  • Mindestens acht Jahre Erfahrung in der Softwareentwicklung, davon mindestens drei Jahre in einer Architektur- oder Tech-Lead-Rolle für ein B2B-SaaS-Produkt; Erfahrung in der fachlichen Führung ohne disziplinarische Verantwortung und sicherer Umgang mit Scrum.

  • AWS-Kenntnisse auf Anwendungsebene, insbesondere EKS/Kubernetes, Lambda, S3 und RDS; Kenntnisse in Terraform und GitLab CI/CD sowie Praxis im Lesen, Reviewen und Schreiben von JavaScript und TypeScript.

  • Erfahrung mit 3D- und Geodaten, etwa 3D Tiles, Meshes, Punktwolken, Photogrammetrie oder GIS-Integration; sehr gute Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift.

  • Wünschenswert: Erfahrung mit Offline-first-Architekturen, KI- und LLM-Integration, Testautomatisierung oder Observability; Deutschkenntnisse und Berührungspunkte mit Bauwerksprüfung, Vermessung, Bauingenieurwesen oder Hydrographie.Du bringst fundierte Erfahrung in der Softwarearchitektur und der Leitung von Entwicklungsteams mit. Der Umgang mit Cloud-Umgebungen, insbesondere AWS, ist für dich vertraut, und du hast Freude daran, komplexe 3D-SaaS-Produkte technologisch voranzutreiben.

Deine Benefits bei uns

  • Umfassendes Onboarding: Strukturierte Einführung und kontinuierliche Betreuung durch eine:n Mentor:in.

  • Verantwortung & Projektvielfalt: Du gestaltest die Architektur einer 3D-SaaS-Plattform und arbeitest mit Inspektionsdaten von Brücken und Wasserstraßen.

  • Kultur & Zusammenarbeit: Wertschätzende Zusammenarbeit in einem hilfsbereiten Team – pragmatisch, lösungsorientiert und auf Augenhöhe.

title: Production Engineer (TL2)
description:
• Location:  UK - Hybrid 

  • Level: TL2

  • Team: Applied Engineering

This role is based in the UK and requires existing right to work in the UK.

At this time, we are not able to offer visa sponsorship for this role. We are committed to building a diverse, global team and our sponsorship policy is evaluated on a role-by-role basis. We encourage you to keep an eye on our careers site to stay informed about future opportunities where we are able to offer visa sponsorship.

Kaluza Overview

Kaluza is the Energy Intelligence Platform, turning energy complexity into seamless coordination. We help energy companies overcome today’s challenges while accelerating the shift to a clean, electrified future.

Our platform orchestrates millions of real-time decisions across homes, devices, markets and grids. By combining predictive algorithms with human-centred design, Kaluza makes clean energy dependable, affordable and adaptive to everyday life.

With teams across Europe, North America, Asia and Australia, and a joint venture with Mitsubishi Corporation in Japan, we power leading companies including OVO, AGL and ENGIE, as well as innovators like Volvo and Volkswagen.

What will I be doing?

  • Drive the architectural design, technical strategy, and reliability engineering of Kaluza's distributed infrastructure to support multi-region scalability and continuous uptime.

  • Champion Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) practices, optimizing system observability, automated incident response, chaos engineering, and post-incident root cause analyses.

  • Build, enhance, and maintain secure Infrastructure as Code (IaC) and CI/CD automation pipelines, minimizing deployment friction across cross-functional engineering teams.

  • Own complex production engineering initiatives end-to-end, acting as a technical authority and key escalation point for mission-critical infrastructure incidents.

  • Mentor and upskill engineers across the department, cultivating a strong culture of operational excellence, modern DevOps practices, and architectural standards.

  • Collaborate closely with product and engineering leaders to balance rapid feature delivery with system performance, security compliance, and infrastructure cost optimization.

About You

Ideally you'll have/be:

  • Strong hands-on production engineering, SRE, or DevOps experience managing high-throughput distributed systems in public cloud environments (AWS/GCP).

  • Demonstrated technical leadership skills with a track record of architecting scalable infrastructure, driving platform ownership, and upskilling team members.

  • Deep proficiency with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform/CloudFormation), container orchestration (Kubernetes/Docker), and modern CI/CD tooling.

  • Hands-on experience with observability and monitoring platforms (Datadog, Prometheus, Grafana) alongside strong scripting or programming skills (Python, Go, or TypeScript).

  • Solid understanding of distributed network design, cloud security best practices, automated failover, and disaster recovery strategies.

What will set you apart:

  • Prior experience in high-concurrency event-driven SaaS architectures, IoT platforms, or the green energy sector.

  • Track record of introducing and scaling SLI/SLO/Error Budget frameworks across multiple product teams.

  • Active contributions to open-source infrastructure tools or cloud-native technology projects.

Kaluza Values

Here at Kaluza we have five core values that guide us as a business:

Play to win, Solve the real problem, Build trust every day, Own the outcome, Go further together.

Our Perks

  • Pension Scheme

  • Discretionary Bonus Scheme

  • Private Medical Insurance + Virtual GP

  • Life Assurance

  • Access to Furthr - a Climate Action app

  • Free Mortgage Advice and Eye Tests

  • Perks at Work - access to thousands of retail discounts

  • 5% Flex Fund - to spend on the benefits you want most

  • 26 days holiday

  • Flexible Bank Holidays - Giving you an additional 8 days which you can choose to take whenever you like

  • Progressive Leave Policy - With no qualifying service periods, including 26 weeks full pay if you have a new addition to your family

  • Personal Learning Budget - Upskill, learn and grow!

  • Home Office Budget

  • And more!

We want the best people

We’re keen to meet people from all walks of life — our view is that the more inclusive we are, the better our work will be. We want to build teams which represent a variety of experiences, perspectives and skills, and we recognise talent on the basis of merit and potential.

We understand some people may not apply for jobs unless they tick every box. But if you're excited about joining us and think you have some of what we're looking for, even if you're not 100% sure, we'd still love to hear from you.

Find out more about working in Kaluza on our careers page and LinkedIn. You can also find our Applicant Data Protection Policy here.

title: Site Reliability Engineer (Platform) - remote friendly
description:
[OUR MISSION AND CUSTOMERS] We are creating the freedom for SMEs to succeed by delivering Europe's leading finance workspace with banking at its core, augmented by financial tools. We are proud to be rated 4.7 on Trustpilot, based on 60,000 reviews. Our culture puts customer satisfaction at the core of what we do (more about our culture here).

 

[OUR JOURNEY] Founded in 2016 and launched in 2017 by Alexandre and Steve, Qonto has grown to 1,700 Qontoers serving over 750,000 customers across 8 European countries. We have been profitable since 2023, and we are just getting started.

 

[OUR BELIEFS] We hire for skills and potential. With 80+ nationalities, 45% women, and 56% of women in our leadership team, diversity isn't a program; It's who we are. We've built a discrimination-free hiring process because the best teams are built on merit.

 

[AI AT QONTO] AI is deeply embedded in how we work (here) - Every Qontoer gets unlimited access to the best AI tools. We want people who experiment without waiting for permission, push AI beyond the obvious, know when to trust it, and when to question it.

 

Location: You can apply to work at Qonto as long as you're living in (or willing to relocate to) either Germany, France, Italy, Serbia, or Spain.

Join us as a Site Reliability Engineer on our Platform SRE team and help keep Qonto fast, reliable and cost-efficient for the businesses that run their finances on it. You'll build and run the infrastructure our product engineers rely on to ship and operate their own services, under the guidance of Matthew, our Lead Platform SRE.

➡️ What you'll do

  • Be the first call for engineers: You'll take your turn on duty, answering product engineers' questions in our SRE Help Desk before getting back to your own deliverables.

  • Own a domain you care about: You'll grow into an area such as scaling Kubernetes, observability or engineer enablement, and make it yours.

  • Level up our microservices architecture: You'll help service teams run their services the same way through our Service Maturity Model initiative.

  • Cut costs through automation: You'll write software that scales our resources up and down with customer demand.

  • Lay the foundations for our AI software factory: You'll build the infrastructure that lets Qonto's engineers develop with AI at scale.

➡️ What we're looking for

  • Collaboration first: You enjoy helping other engineers and teams, even when the question falls outside your own domain.

  • Sharp debugging: You've tracked down hard production problems and can explain how you found the cause.

  • Solid infrastructure foundations: You've run production workloads on a cloud platform (AWS ideally, GCP also welcome) in a mid-size or large company.

  • Comfort with regulation: You've worked where compliance matters, in finance or healthcare for example, and see process as part of the job.

  • AI-native workflow: You use AI tools in your daily work and are curious about what they can do for infrastructure and incidents.

➡️ What we can offer you

  • A seat at the core of our AI strategy: Your team builds the foundational layer Qonto's AI software factory will run on.

  • Scale with real stakes: You'll help Qonto grow to more customers while holding reliability and cost steady, a line few resumes can carry.

  • A big thing of your own: Every SRE owns a major project in a domain they pick, backed by three experienced tech leads.

  • Hard problems ahead: You'll work on topics like our move from a single region towards multi-region.

➡️ Your future manager

You'll report to Matthew, Lead Platform SRE. He leads by serving: he looks for people who love to help, gives each engineer a big thing to own, and values how you work with others as much as your technical depth.

➡️ Our stack & practices

  • Cloud: AWS, currently in a single region as we explore multi-region.

  • Application platform: Kubernetes is our core platform for hosting applications.

  • Data: Postgres for storage and ClickHouse for data collection, with growing usage.

  • Engineering workflow: GitHub for all our code and orchestration.

  • AI in infrastructure: We experiment with AI to detect and debug incidents and to manage our response.

➡️ Our methodology

  • We value upfront technical design, team code reviews, and smart slicing — quality drives the velocity our customers need.

  • Our lean toolbox, Kaizen and PDCA, lets you drive continuous improvement with your peers and manager.

Want to go further? Read about the Qonto Way.


[DIVERSITY] At Qonto, we understand that true diversity isn’t just about ticking boxes on a hiring checklist. Apply regardless of the boxes you tick - who knows? You may have the missing piece of the puzzle we’ve been searching for all along.

[HIRING PROCESS DURATION] On average, our hiring process lasts 20 working days. More information on our candidate journey here

[DATA RETENTION] By applying, you agree that Qonto processes your personal data to assess your application. Your data is kept for up to 2 years in our candidate pool. Read our Privacy Notice for full details.

🔒 Your security matters to us

Recruitment scams are on the rise. Qonto will never work with third-party platforms or agencies that request payment from candidates. If you receive a suspicious message claiming to be from Qonto, please report it to

title: Salesforce Developer
description:
About Us:

Nivoda: Where Innovation and Gemstones Meet 💎

At Nivoda, we’re reimagining how the world buys and sells jewellery. Our global marketplace connects retailers and suppliers across diamonds, gemstones, and finished jewellery - already powering over $300M in annual transactions and scaling fast toward our billion-dollar vision.

We’re bringing tech, data, and automation to a $350B industry that’s barely scratched the surface of digital transformation. The result? Explosive growth and massive opportunity powered by a team that makes it happen.

Our Mission

The idea of Nivoda was inspired by the ongoing inefficiency of diamond trading. We set out to develop the solution to help businesses, regardless of their size or location, increase their sales and margins, whilst removing the operational burden of sourcing diamonds.

The Engineering & RevOps Team

Our Engineering and RevOps teams sit at the heart of everything Nivoda builds. We move fast, take ownership, and obsess over scalable systems that let our commercial teams fly. We’re a remote-first, globally distributed team that values directness, low ego, and big impact. If you want to build meaningful things without layers of bureaucracy, you’re in the right place.

About the Role

We’re looking for a Salesforce Developer to join our growing Salesforce team, working alongside our existing developer and RevOps. We’ve completed our migration from HubSpot to Salesforce, and the focus now is on making our new instance the single home for our commercial processes and tooling. You’ll consolidate and harden what we’ve built, retire legacy tools into Salesforce, and help shape what comes next: deeper Sales Cloud capability, exploring Service Cloud and Marketing Cloud, and putting Salesforce’s newer AI features, including Agentforce, to real use.

What would YOU be doing?

  • Consolidate processes and tooling into Salesforce, replacing point solutions and manual workarounds with flows, Apex and native features

  • Build and maintain Sales Cloud improvements: lead and opportunity automation, routing and round-robin, stage gates, Lightning pages and LWCs

  • Prototype and deliver Agentforce and AI use cases with RevOps, such as rep assistants, next-best-action and record summaries

  • Support the exploration and rollout of Service Cloud (e.g. Cases for onboarding and support processes) and Marketing Cloud

  • Build back-end Salesforce solutions — writing Apex code, managing workflows, process automation, and API integrations

  • Maintain integrations with our GTM stack (Snowflake, Gong, Customer.io, Shopify), working with our data engineering team to keep data clean after the migration

  • Work closely with Sales, Marketing, Revenue Operations, Customer and Supplier-facing teams to understand business requirements and translate them into scalable Salesforce solutions

  • Take part in sprint planning, effort estimation and prioritisation, and deliver on sprint commitments

  • Work a shared sprint backlog with our other Salesforce developer: peer-review code, share on-call bug fixing, and keep documentation current

  • Document everything you build — create and maintain comprehensive technical documentation to ensure smooth handovers and maintainability

What do we need from YOU?

  • Salesforce Platform Developer I certification (essential)

  • Strong Apex coding skills — you write clean, efficient, well-documented code

  • Solid SQL skills and ability to build and map APIs and integrations

  • 2–5 years of Salesforce development experience, ideally in a scaling company

  • Confident with Flow, LWC, SOQL and the Salesforce deployment lifecycle (sandboxes, change sets or SFDX, version control)

  • Strong Sales Cloud experience; exposure to Service Cloud or Marketing Cloud a plus

  • Self-motivated with a strategic mindset — you identify problems before they become fires

  • Collaborative: comfortable sharing a codebase, reviewing others’ work and taking feedback

  • Strong documentation habits — you leave things better than you found them

Nice to have

  • Salesforce Platform Developer II, Service Cloud or Marketing Cloud certifications

  • Experience in marketplace, e-commerce, or SaaS businesses

  • Background in companies at Series A–D stage where you’ve built things from scratch

  • Experience with Snowflake or similar data warehousing tools

  • Experience stabilising or consolidating an org after a CRM migration

  • Hands-on experience with Agentforce, Einstein or Prompt Builder

Our culture and what we offer

At Nivoda, we believe that employees today want to evolve in a collaborative, high-growth environment where they can demonstrate their abilities and thrive both professionally and personally. We are convinced that employees need to find alignment between their inner values and their company’s culture and mission to unlock their full potential. We work to create a culture of empowerment, continuous learning and growth where everyone can bring expertise, own projects and easily measure their impact.

Dynamic working environment in a rapidly growing company.
Enjoy a pleasant, low-hierarchy work environment.
Engage in intellectually challenging work that contributes significantly to Nivoda’s success and scalability.

Our benefits

🕰️ Flexible working hours and a vibrant company culture
💻 Remote work
🧠 Plenty of opportunities for growth and learning
🏖️ Unlimited holiday allowance
🚀 Chance to join and contribute to a company during its exponential expansion phase

Nivoda is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace dedicated to promoting diversity. We don’t discriminate on the basis of race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status or disability status.
Even if it seems you don’t meet 100% of our musts don’t let it stop you, we are all about finding the best talent out there! Skills can be learned, and embracing diversity is invaluable.

Please note: Our Talent Acquisition Team is international coming from across the world. We kindly ask you to please submit your CV and application in English so that it can be reviewed correctly.

*If after reading this job description you believe this is not the best fit for you, we’d encourage you to join our Talent Pool so we can keep you in mind as new roles open up.
You can sign up here: Nivoda Talent Pool

title: Counsel
description:
Flex is building the AI-native private bank for business owners.

We’re re-architecting the entire financial system for entrepreneurs—from the first dollar a business earns to how that value compounds, moves, and is ultimately spent in real life. Banking, credit, payments, personal finance, and financial operations—rebuilt from the ground up as a single, intelligent system. Flex is the full financial home for ambitious owners.

Since launching publicly in September 2023, Flex has scaled from zero to nine-figure annualized revenue, with a clear path to profitability by late 2026. We move fast, ship relentlessly, and operate with extreme ownership.

Our customers are affluent business owners ($3–$200M in revenue)—the backbone of the economy and one of the most underserved segments in finance. They’re stuck with outdated banks and fragmented tools. We’re replacing all of it. The opportunity is massive: a ~$1T+ revenue market hiding in plain sight. Our ambition is to build a $100B+ company by delivering a product that is fundamentally better—not incrementally improved.

Flex has raised $100M+ in equity and $300M+ in debt.

- Mission-critical problems: We build software that directly controls how money moves at scale.

- High bar, low ego: Small teams, exceptional people, real ownership.

- Speed over comfort: We prioritize execution, quality, clarity, and results.

- Enduring impact: What we’re building will define how a generation of owners runs their businesses.

Team & Locations

We hire exceptional people who want to build hard things and see their work matter immediately. Roles are available in: San Francisco, Miami, New York, and fully remote.

Flex Fuels Ambition.

What You'll Do

  • Draft, review, and revise commercial agreements, including NDAs, vendor agreements, customer contracts, and other day-to-day agreements across the business.

  • Support contract negotiations by preparing drafts and redlines, researching issues, and working with senior members of the Legal team to resolve open points.

  • Assist with product and regulatory matters, including researching legal requirements, reviewing product materials and disclosures, and helping prepare terms, policies, notices, and other customer-facing materials.

  • Research federal and state laws and regulations affecting Flex and help turn that research into clear, practical guidance for the Legal & Compliance team and our business partners.

  • Support regulatory and licensing work, including preparing filings, gathering information, maintaining records, and helping respond to requests from regulators, banks, and other partners.

  • Assist with disputes, litigation, collections, and recovery matters, including researching claims, organizing records, preparing correspondence, and coordinating with internal teams and outside counsel.

  • Help maintain Flex's corporate records and support governance and other general corporate matters.

  • Work directly with teams across Flex to gather facts, understand business needs, and help the Legal team respond quickly and effectively.

  • Help build and improve the templates, playbooks, processes, and tools we use to make the Legal function more efficient.

  • Use AI and other technology as part of your everyday practice, and help us find new ways to automate routine legal work and make the entire team better.

What Makes You A Great Fit

  • You're smart, curious, and eager to learn. You don't need to know everything yet - we don't expect you to. But you want to understand why things work the way they do, and you're willing to dig until they make sense.

  • You take pride in your work. Details matter to you. You proofread. You check your work. And you don't consider something finished just because you've reached the bottom of the page.

  • You're comfortable asking questions. You know there's a difference between figuring something out and guessing, and you're not afraid to ask for guidance when you need it.

  • You learn quickly. You take feedback well, apply it the next time, and want your second attempt at something to be noticeably better than your first.

  • You're a strong writer and clear thinker. You can research an unfamiliar issue, identify what matters, and explain what you've found without burying the answer.

  • You're organized and dependable. If you're given an assignment, you keep track of it, communicate about it, and get it done.

  • You want to understand the business. You're interested in more than the legal answer. You want to understand what Flex is building, how our products work, and why the question matters in the first place.

  • You're willing to do the work. No assignment is beneath you, and you understand that becoming a great lawyer means getting the fundamentals right before anything else.

  • You're comfortable with change. Priorities move quickly at a startup, new questions come up constantly, and you won't always have a form, precedent, or perfectly defined assignment waiting for you.

  • You want responsibility and are ready to earn it. We'll give you meaningful work, support, and opportunities to grow. What you do with those opportunities is up to you.

What We're Looking For

  • J.D. from an accredited law school and an active bar license, or eligibility to become admitted promptly.

  • 0–2 years of legal experience. Law firm, in-house, government, judicial clerkship, and other relevant legal experience will all be considered.

  • Strong academic, legal research, writing, and analytical skills.

  • Excellent attention to detail and a commitment to producing accurate, thoughtful work.

  • Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple assignments and deadlines.

  • Good judgment, including knowing when to work through an issue independently and when to ask for help.

  • Strong communication skills and the ability to work effectively with lawyers and non-lawyers across the company.

  • An interest in contracts and commercial work and a desire to develop strong drafting and negotiation skills.

  • An interest in fintech, financial services, technology, or startups. Prior experience in these areas is helpful, but not required.

  • Curiosity about AI and a willingness to learn how to use it responsibly to research, draft, analyze, and work more efficiently.

  • A willingness to take on a broad range of assignments and learn different areas of an in-house legal practice.

  • Genuine excitement about Flex and the opportunity to grow as a lawyer while helping us build the company.

Compensation

Final compensation within this range will be based on experience, qualifications, and interview performance. This position is also eligible for equity compensation. Flex offers medical, dental and vision insurance, paid time off, and a 401(k) plan. Applications will be accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled.

Additional Information

Why Join Us

Build something generational — Capture the full lifecycle of money for ambitious business owners.

Work on real money, real risk — Payments, credit, and banking at serious scale.

Solve hard problems — AI, underwriting, compliance, and global finance from first principles.

True ownership — Small teams, high trust, real accountability.

Founder-level exposure — Direct access to leadership, customers, and investors.

High bar, high taste — Move fast without cutting corners.

Elite peers — People here are builders, not tourists.

Real upside — Meaningful equity if you help build something big.
