title: AWS Cloud Solutions Architect
description:
As a Senior AWS Cloud Solutions Architect, you will be the technical lead on our most complex engagements, from assessment and mobilization to large-scale migration and modernization. You will report to an Engineering Manager based in Europe and lead distributed teams of US- and Budapest-based engineers. You will also work closely with colleagues in our AI/ML and Application Development practices.



What you'll be doing:

  • Lead the technical delivery of complex, high-impact migration and modernization engagements, including AWS Migration Acceleration Program (MAP) assessments and mobilization.

  • Lead technical discovery and design multi-service, cloud-native AWS architectures that turn business goals into scalable blueprints.

  • Technically lead teams of 1â4 engineers, and manage the technical roadmap of 2â3 engagements in parallel.

  • Own technical design decisions within project scope. Resolve technical disagreements and handle scope conversations with clients professionally.

  • Represent Client in customers sessions, including executive-level conversations and joint sessions with AWS stakeholders.

  • Spend around 25% of your time on pre-sales: discovery, solution design and co-selling with AWS account teams in North America.

  • Resolve high-risk technical blockers and escalations, including critical production incidents.

  • Adapt to changing delivery expectations and keep engagements on track under uncertainty.

  • Build architectural guardrails, reusable frameworks and components that raise quality across the practice.

  • Coach engineers and share knowledge through internal sessions, workshops, whitepapers and technical evangelism.

  • Be the go-to expert in one or more domains, such as MSSQL Server, PostgreSQL, EKS, VMware, data, security or networking.

  • Help shape our technical offerings and accelerators in line with market and AWS trends.



What you bring:

  • 8+ years in infrastructure or cloud engineering, including 5+ years designing and delivering on AWS.

  • A proven track record of leading at least two large-scale cloud migrations end to end.

  • Hands-on database migration experience with MSSQL Server, Oracle or PostgreSQL.

  • AWS Certified Solutions Architect â Professional.

  • In-depth knowledge of core AWS services, including:

    • Compute and containers: EC2, Lambda, ECS, EKS

    • Storage and databases: S3, RDS, EFS, EBS

    • Networking and integration: VPC, API Gateway, CloudFront, SNS, SQS

    • Security: IAM, Security Hub, GuardDuty, KMS, AWS Private CA

    • Operations and migration: CloudWatch, AWS Application Migration Service

  • Strong Infrastructure as Code skills. Terraform is preferred; CloudFormation, AWS CDK or Ansible are also welcome.

  • Hands-on experience building and running CI/CD pipelines with GitHub Actions, GitLab, Bitbucket or similar.

  • Experience running containerized workloads with Docker and Kubernetes or EKS.

  • Strong networking knowledge: TCP/IP, DNS, load balancers, firewalls and VPN, plus AWS networking services such as VPC, Route 53, ELB and CloudFront.

  • Strong security knowledge: IAM, least privilege, access control, endpoint security and data encryption.

  • Excellent problem-solving and communication skills. You are confident with executives and engineering teams alike.

  • Comfort working in a distributed team, with a few hours of daily overlap with Central European Time.

  • A bachelor's degree in Computer Science, IT or a related field, or equivalent experience.


Nice to have:

  • Hands-on experience with AWS MAP phases: Assess, Mobilize, and Migrate & Modernize.

  • Migrations from VMware, on-premises data centers, Azure or GCP.

  • Experience with AI-assisted migration and modernization tooling, such as AWS Transform.

  • AWS Specialty certifications, such as Security or Advanced Networking.

title: Inside Sales Contractor
description:
About Us

We are a financial services start up focusing on helping to improve consumer credit profiles. We are currently seeking KPI driven sales representatives looking to earn up to 45K in their first year while working remotely. We offer comprehensive training and continuous sales coaching to help you meet your financial goals.

During our training period we offer a guaranteed training stipend while our trainees are acclimating to the position (*see weekly pay below). If you are a seasoned sales professional looking for the autonomy of a remote position combined with great compensation, we want to hear from you!

Compensation Structure

This role is 100% commission-based, which means your earning potential is unlimited. In addition, we regularly offer competitive performance-based bonuses to reward hard work and results.

Training Period (Weeks 1–4)

We invest in your success and want to make sure you’re supported as you get up to speed:

  • Week 1: Commission-only (a chance to start earning right away while learning the ropes).

  • Weeks 2–4: Guaranteed training stipend of $500 USD total – or your commission if it’s higher. You’ll always receive whichever amount benefits you most.

    • Week 0: Unpaid

    • Week 1: $100 guaranteed minimum

    • Week 2: $150 guaranteed minimum

    • Week 3: $250 guaranteed minimum

By the end of training, you’ll have the skills to maximize commissions, with the safety net of a guaranteed base during your ramp-up period.

Post Training Period:

  • Average first year OTE: 25K-35K (US) Annually

  • Top Rep first year OTE: 35K-45K (US) Annually

*The above is the average pay you can expect, however, there is unlimited earning potential for those who are financially motivated top performers looking to exceed sales targets.

What will you be doing?

Educating inbound callers on their credit standing by providing consultations with the goal of enrolling them in one of our services should they be a good fit.

We are looking for team members who are:

  • Tech savvy with the ability to navigate digital tools such as SLACK, CRM software, google sheets, etc. Our team uses these digital tools daily.

  • Growth oriented and always looking to learn and acquire new skills.

  • Autonomous self starters who can work independently and efficiently.

  • Team players with the ability to implement feedback from their sales coaches.

  • Patient and professional with clients. Finances can be a difficult topic for some clients to discuss. We are looking for individuals who showcase empathy and professionalism especially under pressure!

  • Financially motivated individuals who can meet and exceed sales targets.

  • Outgoing with outstanding rapport building and active listening skills. Can you carry a conversation with anyone? This may be for you!

You will need:

(*Please Note: Devices such as Chromebooks, IPADs and laptops with 8G’s of RAM and under will have issues supporting our system)

Scheduling

title: Tier III Service Desk Engineer
description:
Unió Digital is an Arizona-based managed service provider (MSP) delivering Managed IT Services, Low Voltage Cabling, Access Control, Video Surveillance, and Intrusion Services. We believe technology should be intuitive, not intimidating.

 

We are looking for an experienced Tier 3 Service Desk Technician with exceptional problem-solving skills. You will serve as the escalation point within the team, resolving complex technical issues while also leading client onboarding and project initiatives. You are expected to be involved in direct end-user support when required. If you have a passion for ensuring top-quality user support and thrive in a collaborative environment, this role is for you.

 

Duties

 

·       Lead and support our helpdesk environment for managed service clients

 

·       Coordinate and manage client projects, acting as a bridge between the technical team and the client to ensure project success

 

·       Provide above and beyond support to our clients and respond to queries for technical assistance in person, via phone, or electronically as required

 

·       Provide training and support to clients during the onboarding process to ensure they understand how to effectively use their new IT systems and services.

 

·       Develop project plans for client onboarding and standardization projects, outlining tasks, resources required, and estimated timelines

 

·       Install, configure, diagnose, test and resolve technical hardware and software issues

 

·       Maintain and update written client and process documentation to ensure effective knowledge management

 

·       Provide mentorship and guidance to Tier I and Tier II service desk technicians, fostering a collaborative and knowledgeable team environment

 

·       Contribute to the development and improvement of IT service management processes and practices

 

·       Evaluate and anticipate IT trends and recommend strategies and implement improvement initiatives

 

Our Technology Stack

 

·       Helpdesk / Ticketing – HaloPSA

 

·       Documentation – Hudu

 

·       RMM – Intune / Immybot

 

·       Networking – Meraki

 

·       Email/Calendar/Voice/AD – Microsoft 365

 

·       Security Cameras – Rhombus / Avigilon

 

·       Door Access – Avigilon

 

Qualification

 

·       6+ years of experience providing IT services and end-user support

 

·       Prior experience at a managed service provider is critical to understand the fast-paced nature of the industry

 

·       Client-oriented approach with a passion for delivering high-quality customer service

 

·       Proven experience leading IT projects

 

·       A self-starter who is eager to expand their qualifications

 

·       Background in providing direct end-user support

 

·       High level of attention to detail

 

·       Excellent verbal and written communication skills

 

·       IT-related degree and/or certifications (Cisco, A+, Network+, Microsoft, or equivalent)

 

·       Advanced technical knowledge, including experience with Azure AD, Active Directory, Intune, or other RMM agents

 

Our Core Values

 

Dream Big, Then Make it Real

 

We flex our imagination and challenge ourselves to a higher standard.  Do, rather than talk and tell.

 

Client Driven Results

 

Clients trust us to find solutions that deliver exceptional results.  When they succeed, we succeed.

 

Own Your Progress

title: Strategy & Operations Coach APAC
description:
About The Role

We are looking for senior leaders in strategy & operations roles who value learning, growth, and community and who are passionate about developing and coaching people in their field.

We are specifically looking for coaches who have experience in Singapore or Hong Kong serving the SEA region, or experience in market including Japan, India, South Korea, and Australia.

As a Mento coach, you will form 1:1 partnerships with our members to help them identify & track clear goals, become a better leader, communicate more effectively, problem solve issues at work, and help them feel happy, fulfilled, and engaged at work and beyond.

All Mento coaches, regardless of coaching experience, are required to participate in our ICF-certified coach training program to learn Mentoâs coaching methodology prior to working with our members. Our coach training is an immersive, transformational training designed to help you grow as a coach, master the Mento Coaching Methodology, and gain access to proprietary tools that set our coaches apart. This program is ICF-certified, and participants who successfully graduate will earn Continuing Coach Education Units. If youâre ready to elevate your coaching skills, deepen your impact, and become part of a groundbreaking coaching team, we encourage you to apply and take the next step in your journey!

Your routine responsibilities will include:

  • Providing 1:1 coaching to Mento members through virtual sessions using the Mento Platform and Tools

  • Participating in ongoing training sessions to improve coaching abilities and skills

  • Communicating with members via your Mento email or via chat in the Mento App in between sessions

  • Being an integral member of the Mento coaching community by sharing coaching tools and insights â helping enhance our coaching practices and fulfill our mission of empowering people to thrive in jobs that they love

  • Acting with kindness, respect, and empathy as an ambassador of the Mento community

Who are you?

You areâ¦

  • A director, vice president, or other senior strategy & operations leader with 20+ years experience managing strategy & ops teams and coaching individuals (coaching certification is a plus but not required).

  • Someone who wants to turn their people leadership skills into meaningful coaching skills.

  • Passionate about helping people advance in the workplace to build fulfilling careers and lives.

  • A person who is self aware, who has a high emotional IQ, and who cares about creating a safe space for others to risk being vulnerable.

  • Excited about growing your coaching skills, and you bring a growth-mindset to the experience, regardless of how long you have been a coach.

  • Comfortable working in a constantly-changing startup environment.

  • Able to dedicate a minimum of 12+ hours per month to coaching at Mento for the next 24+ months.

At Mento, we invite new coaches to join us on a rolling basis. The time frame on which we add new coaches is based on the particular needs of our clients and their teams. While we may not need to add an Operations & Strategy VP Coach today, we would still be very excited for you to get in touch with us now if this opportunity resonates with you.

Other details

  • This is a contract position in which coaches are paid per hour. On top of a flat hourly rate, we offer select bonuses that incentivizes engagement with our membership and community growth on our platform

  • You must have the capacity to give a minimum of three to five hours per week towards Mento regardless of other commitments and how they may change.

  • You are able to work with Mento for a minimum of 24 months in order to build meaningful relationships with our members.

  • This is a fully remote position. Candidates must be based in North America or Europe.

  • Because this is a part-time growth opportunity, we are looking to hire experienced senior leaders who want to expand their coaching skills.

Our Hiring Philosophy:
All new Mento coaches are required to participate and graduate from our ICF certified coach training program: Mento Coaching 101. This training is rigorous, and our goal is that all participants are able to be matched with members soon after they complete it. We want to make sure that we are both setting our coaches up for success and respecting everyoneâs time. Therefore, we hire based on incoming member demand. While we are constantly looking and interviewing for the best coaches to join our team, we will only send offers to candidates for whom we have an immediate need. Candidates who receive a YES from Mento after the interview process will either be sent an offer to join the next monthly Coaching 101 training or be added to our coach shortlist to join us when the demand is there.

Inclusion Statement:
We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Research shows that candidates from unrepresented backgrounds may not apply to jobs unless they meet 100% of the job requirements. We strongly believe that diversity of experience, perspectives, and background will lead to a better environment for our employees and a better product for our users. We encourage you to apply even if you do not meet all the requirements.

title: Projektmanager TGA / MEP (m/w/d) - Remote (DE)
description:
At Ruby, your personality really matters, your time really matters, and we strongly believe we groove way better together. At Ruby, we keep breaking new ground.

Hey Sunshine,

du bist ein Profi, wenn es um die Planung und Magie hinter den Kulissen geht? Du findest, dass dein Arbeitsplatz ein Ort mit Charakter und Seele sein sollte, wo neue Ideen zum Leben erweckt werden? Dann bist du die fehlende Olive in unserem Martini, die fehlende Melodie in unserer Musik und der Herzschlag unseres Rubyverse.

Du kennst Baustellen. Du kennst TGA. Und du weißt auch: Zwischen Planung und Realität liegen oft Welten. Du hast keine Lust mehr, nur auf der Baustelle „rumzuspringen“, sondern willst den Überblick behalten, Qualität sichern und die richtigen Entscheidungen zur richtigen Zeit treffen.

Kurz gesagt: Du stellst die richtigen Fragen, challengest Planungen und sorgst dafür, dass unsere Standards nicht nur auf dem Papier stehen, sondern auch umgesetzt werden.

Wir sind eine stark wachsende Hospitality-Gruppe mit bestehenden Hotels und Workspaces in den spannendsten Locations Europas und vielen weiteren Projekten im Bau. Wir gehen mit unserer Lean Luxury Philosophie neue Wege und schaffen so eine zeitgemäße und bezahlbare Form von Luxus. Unser in München bündelt hierbei alle Bau- bzw. Design-, Verwaltungs- und Vermarktungsfunktionen sowie viele aus dem Hotel ausgelagerte Front Office Tätigkeiten.

Join us and make it your own story

Bei uns wird dir garantiert nicht langweilig, denn du:

  • Begleitest unsere Hotelprojekte in ganz Europa im Bereich TGA (KG 400)
  • Übernimmst die fachliche Verantwortung für die Gewerke Elektro und HLSK
  • Prüfst externe Fachplanungen aus Ruby Sicht und bringst unsere Anforderungen frühzeitig ein
  • Stellst sicher, dass unsere technischen und qualitativen Standards konsequent umgesetzt werden
  • Challengest und berätst Fachplaner:innen, Investor:innen und Projektpartner:innen auf Augenhöhe
  • Begleitest Projekte von der Planung über die Umsetzung bis hin zu Inbetriebnahme und Übergabe
  • Unterstützt in der Umsetzungsphase mit Blick auf Qualität, Funktion und die Details, die den Unterschied machen
  • Bist regelmäßig vor Ort auf unseren Baustellen – arbeitest aber überwiegend remote/im Büro
  • Übernimmst im Rahmen unserer FF&E-Projekte die Ausschreibung, Vergabe und Abwicklung der Gewerke Sound, IT, Gastro und KeyCard

Wir haben schon auf dich gewartet, denn du:

  • Hast ein Studium im Bereich HKLS / Gebäudetechnik oder eine vergleichbare Ausbildung
  • Bringst Erfahrung aus der TGA-Fachbauleitung, Fachplanung oder einer vergleichbaren Rolle mit
  • Kennst Baustellen aus erster Hand – hast aber Lust, stärker übergeordnet zu arbeiten
  • Fühlst dich sicher in der Planprüfung, Qualitätssicherung und Projektkoordination
  • Hast ein gutes technisches Verständnis über alle Projektphasen hinweg – von Planung bis Übergabe
  • Arbeitest strukturiert, eigenverantwortlich und behältst auch bei vielen Schnittstellen den Überblick
  • Bist gerne unterwegs, freust dich aber genauso über fokussiertes Arbeiten im Büro / remote
  • Sprichst sehr gut Deutsch und Englisch

What's in for you? So grooven wir:

Sharing is caring – mit unserem Opening-Bonus, wächst mit Ruby auch dein Konto Egal, wie du zur Arbeit kommst – einen Mobility-Zuschuss gibt's on top Take it to the next level – sichere dir extra Cash durch Talent Scouting, halbjährliche Sonderzahlungen und eine individuelle Bonusvereinbarung Level up your game – mit Trainings, Coaching und Mentoring hast du die Chance, genau so sehr über dich hinauszuwachsen, wie auch Ruby wächst Innovation ist Teil unserer DNA – Lean Luxury, paperless, cashless, … you name it

Where have you been so long?

Daily business? Nicht mit uns. Egal, ob du einen Blick fürs Detail hast oder mit deiner kreativen und innovativen Art neue Wege gehen willst, ob du technikaffin bist oder doch eher Zahlen deine Leidenschaft sind - bei Ruby findest sicherlich auch du bald deinen Platz. Wir suchen ständig außergewöhnliche Charaktere und leidenschaftliche Team Player.

Statt auf perfekte Lebensläufe setzen wir viel mehr Wert auf tolle Persönlichkeiten, die uns dabei helfen, Hotels und Workspaces mit Herz und Seele zu gestalten. Was auch immer deine Leidenschaft ist: Komm zu uns und schreibe deine eigene Geschichte mit Ruby.

Diversity, Equity & Inclusion

Wir glauben daran, dass...
...du lieben kannst, wen du willst
...du selbst entscheiden solltest, ob und mit welchen Pronomen du angesprochen werden möchtest
...du stolz auf deine Herkunft und Kultur sein kannst
...du dich nicht für deine Religion oder Weltanschauung rechtfertigen musst
...du gut bist, genauso wie du bist und unser Team und Rubys Vielfältigkeit einzigartig machst

Damit können wir gar nicht: Ismen
Rassismus, Sexismus, Heterosexismus, Antisemitismus und alle weiteren derartigen Ismen, werden bei uns nicht toleriert.

Wenn du wissen möchtest, was dich erwartet, dann höre doch mal in unsere Ruby Stories rein:

Get to know our People & Culture Team

description:
Über diese Stelle

Als Software-Entwickler bei H. Wagner + Partner arbeiten Sie an anspruchsvollen Projekten für namhafte Banken und Finanzinstitute. Sie entwickeln und pflegen Systeme für das Wertpapierdatenmanagement – Anwendungen mit hohen Anforderungen an Stabilität, Präzision und Langlebigkeit. Bei uns arbeiten Sie nicht an kurzlebigen Projekten, sondern an Software, die über Jahre zuverlässig ihren Dienst verrichtet.

Ihre Aufgaben

  • Softwarelösungen rund um WIPS: Weiterentwicklung, Implementierung und Wartung.

  • Durchführung von Code-Reviews und Qualitätssicherung

  • Dokumentation von Software und Entwicklungsprozessen

  • Fehleranalyse und Behebung von Bugs

  • Analyse von Anforderungen und Erstellung technischer Konzepte

Das bringen Sie mit

  • Fundierte Erfahrung in der Entwicklung unter IBM z/OS-Systemen

  • Erfahrung mit JCL zur Steuerung von Batch-Prozessen

  • Kenntnisse in TSO/ISPF zur Entwicklung und Fehleranalyse

  • Selbstständiges, strukturiertes, lösungsorientiertes Arbeiten

  • Sichere Kommunikation auf Deutsch und Englisch

  • Abgeschlossenes Studium der Informatik oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation

  • Vertrautheit mit Debugging- und Analyse-Tools im z/OS-Umfeld

  • Fähigkeit, bestehende Assembler-Programme zu analysieren, zu warten und weiterzuentwickeln

  • Sehr gute Kenntnisse in High Level Assembler (HLASM)

Wünschenswert

  • Erfahrung im Umgang mit CICS und/oder IMS DC

  • Kenntnisse in Datenbanken (IMS DB, DB2)

  • Bankenwissen Wertpapiere

  • Fundierte Kenntnisse in weiteren Programmiersprachen (z. B. Java, C++)

Das bieten wir Ihnen

  • Attraktive Vergütung: Faire, marktgerechte Bezahlung.

  • Moderne Arbeitsumgebung und Technologien.

  • Ein motiviertes und kollegiales Team.

  • Mobilität: JobRad-Angebote

Ihre Vorteile

  • Unbefristetes Arbeitsverhältnis

  • Langfristige Perspektive von Anfang an — kein Projekt auf Zeit.

  • Sicher in die Zukunft

  • Kleine Teams

  • Arbeitgeberfinanzierte Altersvorsorge.

  • Flexibel arbeiten, wie es passt

  • Weiterbildungen (Fortbildungsmöglichkeiten und Zertifizierungen. Wir investieren in Ihre fachliche Entwicklung)

  • Technische Tiefe (Komplexe Systeme und anspruchsvolle Datenstrukturen. Arbeiten Sie an Software, die wirklich funktionieren muss)

  • Gleitzeit / Work-Life-Balance

  • Remote / Homeoffice

  • Deutschlandweit

Unsere Arbeitskultur

Bei H. Wagner + Partner erwartet Sie ein ruhiges, konzentriertes Arbeitsumfeld. Wir setzen auf Qualität statt Quantität, auf durchdachte Lösungen statt schneller Hacks.

Unsere Teams sind klein und überschaubar. Jeder kennt jeden, Entscheidungswege sind kurz, und Ihre Arbeit hat direkten Einfluss auf das Produkt.

Wir glauben an nachhaltiges Arbeiten: Keine Überstundenkultur, keine unrealistischen Deadlines, keine Startup-Hektik. Stattdessen: Fundierte Planung, professionelle Umsetzung, zufriedene Kunden.

Technologie-Stack

Wir arbeiten mit bewährten Technologien, die im Finanzsektor Standard sind:

  • Host-/Mainframe-Systeme (IBM z/OS, z/VSE)

  • Windows Server & Client-Anwendungen

  • Webtechnologien (HTML, CSS, JavaScript)

  • Datenbanken (DB2, SQL Server, Oracle)

  • Batch-Verarbeitung & Jobsteuerung

  • Datenschnittstellen & APIs

Wie keine andere Agentur nutzt palmerhargreaves schon heute alle Möglichkeiten der generativen KI, um die Kommunikation ihrer Kunden noch effizienter und effektiver zu machen. Die Agentur beschäftigt über 100 Mitarbeitende aus 12 Nationen. Zu den Kunden zählen weltbekannte Marken wie Audi, Bayer, Deutsche Telekom, Ford, Henkel und SAP.

Als Junior PR Consultant ergänzt du unser ambitioniertes Team, das für namhafte, internationale Kunden Kommunikationsstrategien entwickelt und umsetzt. Diese abwechslungsreiche Position richtet sich an Interesst:innen mit erster Berufserfahrung aus dem Agenturumfeld, die eigenständig Kunden und Projekte betreuen möchten.

  • Du arbeitest bei der Ausgestaltung von PR-Kampagnen, Medien-Events, Fotoshootings, Bewegtbildformaten und maßgeschneiderten PR-Tools mit

  • Du bearbeitest Presseanfragen und pflegst Presseverteiler

  • Du nimmst an Kundenterminen teil und bereitest diese mit vor

Das bringst du mit

  • Erfolgreich abgeschlossene/s Ausbildung und/oder Studium, mit einem journalistischen Hintergrund

  • Erste, einschlägige Berufserfahrung im Bereich Medien-, Presse- und Öffentlichkeitsarbeit sowie Agenturerfahrung

description:
Über diese Rolle

Du liebst es, wenn alles seinen Platz hat, und willst HR in einem schnell wachsenden Unternehmen mitgestalten?

Als HR People Operations (m/w/d) bist du die rechte Hand unserer HR-Managerin. Du sorgst dafür, dass Verträge, Personalakten und Prozesse sitzen, begleitest neue Kolleg:innen vom ersten Tag an und übernimmst eigene kleine HR-Projekte.

Wir sind ein schnell wachsendes E-Commerce Scale Up mit Sitz in der Speicherstadt Hamburg. Unsere Mission ist es, Kinder mit innovativen Produkten für das lebenslange Lernen zu begeistern und das Leben von Millionen Familien liebevoller und bunter zu gestalten.

Bewirb dich jetzt und gestalte aktiv die Zukunft eines dynamischen Unternehmens mit!

Deine Aufgaben

  • Verträge & Dokumente: Du bereitest Arbeitsverträge, NDAs, Zeugnisse und Bescheinigungen vor und achtest darauf, dass alles fehlerfrei und pünktlich ist.

  • Personalakten & Personio: Du pflegst unsere digitalen Personalakten und Mitarbeiterdaten in Personio, sodass alles jederzeit vollständig und aktuell ist.

  • Recruiting-Support: Du stellst Stellenanzeigen ein, sichtest Bewerbungen vor und koordinierst Interviews.

  • On- & Offboarding: Du bereitest den Start neuer Kolleg:innen vor und begleitest Austritte administrativ, von Unterlagen bis zu Geräten und Zugängen.

  • Kleine HR-Projekte: Du übernimmst eigenständig kleine Projekte, z. B. Feedback-Umfragen, Vorlagen oder Prozessdokumentation.

Dein Profil

  • Du hast 1–2 Jahre Erfahrung in HR, z. B. in der Personalsachbearbeitung, HR-Administration oder im Recruiting.

  • Du arbeitest sicher mit Personio.

  • Du arbeitest extrem sorgfältig und zuverlässig, denn in Verträgen und Personaldaten zählt jedes Detail.

  • Du hast einen hohen Anspruch an deine eigene Arbeit und gibst dich nicht mit „gut genug“ zufrieden.

  • Du gehst diskret mit vertraulichen Informationen um.

  • Du lebst in Hamburg oder Umgebung und bist regelmäßig bei uns im Office.

title: Customer Success Associate
description:
About Aphex

We're the construction coordination platform that's replacing outdated spreadsheets with multiplayer tools that delivery teams love. Major contractors like BAM, Balfour Beatty, SKANSKA, Kier, MACE, and Murphy use Aphex to deliver their projects ranging from £50 million to multi-billion pound mega projects.

Since launching in 2019, we've grown to become the market-leading solution in the UK and Australia, with aspirations to be where every major project in the world is planned and delivered.

We're tackling an industry that drives 10% of global GDP yet has seen productivity decline for 20 years. It's time for change.

 

The Role

As a Customer Success Associate at Aphex, you'll learn our Land & Expand Engine inside one of the highest-paced teams at the company: the UK Customer Success Hub.

Your job is to help major contractors get genuine value out of Aphex on their live projects. You'll be in the room and on site with planners, engineers, construction managers, and project directors, helping them embed weekly planning routines, daily coordination, and the reporting that makes their projects run better.

This is a fast progression role. You'll start in apprentice mode alongside the UK CS team, learning the playbook by doing it. Within 6 to 9 months, most CSAs are running their own portfolio of projects as full Customer Success Managers. We hire people who are hungry for that progression and ready to earn it from day one, not waiting until month nine.

The team you're joining is in the middle of a step change: scaling the UK book and expanding into new geographical markets. The CSAs we hire now are part of how the UK CS function holds together and grows through that period.

AI is part of how the team works at Aphex. We expect everyone to use it to think, write, plan, and analyse better. Genuine curiosity about how AI can multiply your output is part of the job.

At Aphex we challenge the status quo as a default. As you grow in this role, you'll be expected to propose better ways of working and make them real, not wait for someone to ask.

 

What you'll learn and do

  • Run project deployments. Shadow experienced CSMs through kickoffs, setups, and training, then take the lead on your own.

  • Embed planning routines. Help major contractor teams establish the weekly planning cycle that becomes their project's operating rhythm.

  • Drive daily coordination. Move teams from weekly planning into the daily routines that make site coordination genuinely better.

  • Build trusted relationships across the project. Engineers, supervisors, planners, project managers, construction managers. Hold real credibility at every level.

  • Monitor project health and act on it. Track signals, spot risks early, run plays to fix issues before they escalate.

 

The team you'll join

You'll be part of the UK Customer Success Hub, working directly alongside four Customer Success Managers who collectively support projects worth billions in construction value across the UK's largest contractors. You'll learn by working live deployments with them, not from a training course.

You'll also work closely with our UK sales team to understand how project success translates into account growth, and collaborate with our APAC hub on shared accounts, knowledge sharing, and the global playbook we run across regions.

 

Why this matters

Every project you help succeed means a real project gets delivered better. Less waste, less delay, less rework, less pressure on the people doing the work. You're not just supporting software adoption, you're helping the UK's biggest contractors deliver the infrastructure and buildings the country actually needs.

 

About You

At Aphex, we believe our team should reflect the variety of perspectives in the world we build for. We've noticed that qualified candidates from underrepresented groups sometimes hesitate to apply unless they meet 100% of the listed requirements, while others might apply when meeting just 60%. If you're excited about Aphex and believe you have the core skills to succeed in this role, we encourage you to apply, even if you don't check every box. Your unique perspective might be exactly what we need.

 

What we're looking for:

  • You build trust quickly with people across all kinds of roles and seniority. You've held real relationships beyond the transaction. People you've worked with before still take your call.

  • You've been thrown in over your head and figured it out. At least one specific story (probably more) of taking on something you weren't qualified for and getting up to speed fast.

  • You don't wait to be asked. When you spot something that isn't working (a broken process, a missing resource, an awkward workflow), you take it on yourself to fix it.

 

Nice to have:

  • A second European language relevant to our growth into new markets

  • Previous experience in customer success, SaaS, or a fast-moving B2B environment

  • Some construction or infrastructure background or curiosity (deep industry knowledge isn't required; curiosity for the work matters)

  • Evidence of using AI tools to improve how you work, with a clear view of where AI helps and where it doesn't

Benefits

What we offer:

  • 25 days holiday plus UK bank holidays

  • Bupa Health & Dental Care

  • Pension contribution

  • Parental leave

  • Remote-first working with access to a WeWork office for in-person collaboration

  • The right tools. MacBook Pro setup, modern tech stack, and AI tooling across the team

  • Genuine development. Personal training allowance plus ongoing coaching and learning support

  • A team that takes the work seriously. Collaborative, ambitious people who care about doing the work well

 

Interview & Application Process

Our interview process is typically 2-3 rounds, focused on mutual fit and long-term alignment. As a remote-first business with teams across the UK, Europe, and APAC, parts of the process may run asynchronously.

description:

As we build more tools used directly by traders, we are looking for a Business Analyst with strong front-office fixed income e-trading experience to help shape what we build and how we build it.

We provide a low-latency, high-throughput distributed messaging system for e-trading fixed income markets. We are, foremost, a technology service provider and support for part of our customers’ trading infrastructure. Our core products involve API connectivity and GUIs for electronic trading.

Bonus points if you:

  • Have knowledge across more than one fixed income product or asset class.

  • Have a formal background as a fixed income trader.

title: Ingénieur(e) Paramétrage Paie
description:
Alassio recrute son ou sa Ingénieur(e) Paramétrage Paie !

En un coup d'œil

  • Contrat : CDI

  • Lieu : Paris ou Aix-en-Provence ; hybride

  • Équipe : Métier

  • Expérience : 2 à 5 ans en paie, avec une forte composante paramétrage

 
 

Missions

 

🏗️ Alassio, en quelques mots

Le marché de la paie en cabinet d'expertise comptable est dominé depuis des décennies par des solutions historiques. Chez Alassio, notre ambition est de rénover le métier au bénéfice des gestionnaires de paie, avec un logiciel moderne, évolutif et pensé pour les réalités du terrain.

Lancé en juillet 2025 et déployé en clientèle depuis mars 2026, Alassio a levé 2,6 M€ en pre-seed auprès de Partech et de business angels de référence. Nous accélérons pour accompagner de nouveaux cabinets partout en France, tout en maintenant une exigence forte sur la qualité du produit et de l'accompagnement.

 

🎯 Pourquoi ce poste, maintenant

Nous étendons en continu la couverture d'Alassio à de nouvelles conventions collectives et à de nouveaux dispositifs réglementaires. Chaque paramétrage se retrouve sur des milliers de bulletins : ta rigueur garantit la justesse des paies de nos cabinets, et ta réactivité leur permet d'obtenir vite les ajustements dont ils ont besoin.

 

🚀 Ton rôle

Tu fais évoluer le moteur de paie d'Alassio : c'est toi qui traduis les règles de paie (conventions collectives, dispositifs réglementaires, cas particuliers) en paramétrage fiable, utilisé par tous nos cabinets. Tu travailles avec les équipes Métier et Juridique à l'extension réglementaire d'Alassio, en t'appuyant sur les workflows IA d'intégration et de mise à jour des paramètres légaux et conventionnels que nous avons développés.

 

🧭 Tes missions

  • Réaliser et maintenir le paramétrage du moteur : rubriques, cotisations, profils de paie et conventions collectives

  • Traiter les demandes de paramétrage de bout en bout : diagnostic, analyse, paramétrage et livraison, en lien avec notre équipe Juridique

  • Requalifier les cas limites : distinguer ce qui relève du moteur, du paramétrage propre au dossier du cabinet ou d'une évolution produit

  • Mettre en œuvre les évolutions réglementaires : analyser, paramétrer et tester les changements de taux, de plafonds et de règles

  • Traiter les corrections issues du support : vérifier et ajuster les modifications analysées, puis les valider et les implémenter

  • Tester chaque paramétrage livré : tests de conformité et de non-régression, construction et entretien des jeux de tests

  • Fiabiliser le workflow IA d'intégration des CCN : contrôler, tester et corriger ce qu'il produit

  • Gérer la file des demandes : prioriser, suivre et accompagner la validation des livrables

  • Documenter les paramétrages réalisés

  • Analyser des cas clients pour identifier l'origine d'un écart de calcul

  • Remonter au Product les anomalies et les besoins d'évolution du produit

 

🤝 Ton environnement

  • Tu travailles au quotidien avec Huy Anh (Resp. Métier) et Ludivine (Resp. Juridique)

  • Tu travailles également avec l'équipe Support, l'équipe Tech et l'équipe Déploiement & Accompagnement (DnA)

  • Outils : Alassio, Linear, Notion, outils d'IA développés par Alassio

 

🗓️ Tes 6 premiers mois

  • À 1 mois : tu maîtrises le moteur de paramétrage et le workflow IA des CCN, et tes premières corrections sont validées en binôme

  • À 3 mois : tu reprends en autonomie le paramétrage quotidien, avec des jeux de tests de non-régression en place sur ton périmètre

  • À 6 mois : tu pilotes en autonomie une campagne d'évolutions réglementaires et tu tiens les délais de traitement des corrections

 
 

Profil recherché

 

🌱 Expérience

Indispensable :

  • Formation en paie ou en RH, ou expérience équivalente

  • 2 à 5 ans d'expérience en paie avec une forte composante paramétrage : consultant(e) paramétrage ou expert(e) fonctionnel(le) chez un éditeur, gestionnaire de paie référent(e) outil, ou paramétrage SIRH

  • Pratique approfondie d'un logiciel de paie du marché

  • Aisance dans la lecture et l'interprétation des conventions collectives

  • Esprit logique et rigueur de test : tu ne valides pas un paramétrage sans l'avoir vérifié sur des cas concrets

  • Bonne connaissance de la DSN

Un plus :

  • Notions de code (Python) ou de logique de formules avancées

  • Utilisation avancée des outils d'IA

 

💎 Qualités

  • La rigueur et l'autonomie

  • La curiosité pour la tech et l'IA

  • La capacité à tenir les pics d'activité

 
 

Processus de sélection

1️⃣ Appel d'introduction avec Hector (COO) : 30 min

2️⃣ Entretien métier avec Huy Anh (Resp. Métier) : 45 min

3️⃣ Cas pratique en direct avec Huy Anh : paramétrer une disposition conventionnelle (par exemple une prime d'ancienneté ou un maintien de salaire) et écrire les cas de test associés : 1 h

4️⃣ Rencontre avec l'équipe : 1 h

👉 Le processus se termine par des prises de référence.

 
 

Ce que nous offrons

 

👊 Une mission unique

Être au cœur du moteur de paie d'un logiciel nouvelle génération, travailler avec l'IA au quotidien et voir ton travail utilisé chaque mois sur les bulletins de milliers de salariés.

 

🎁 Rémunération et avantages

  • 💰 Rémunération fixe de 60 à 75K€ selon l'expérience + BSPCE

  • 🏥 Mutuelle Alan

  • 🍽️ Carte Swile (titres-restaurant)

  • 💻 Matériel informatique haut de gamme (MacOS, écran incurvé)

  • 🏡 Télétravail régulier possible

  • 🤓 Offsites d'équipe réguliers (un par trimestre en moyenne)

 

Certaines personnes hésitent à postuler quand elles ne cochent pas toutes les cases. Si tu hésites, postule quand même : on en parlera volontiers.

 

➡️ Prochaines étapes

Si la mission te parle, postule via le formulaire de candidature. Pour toute question, écris à Pour en savoir plus sur Alassio : alassio.fr

title: Enterprise Solutions Architect
description:
We are rebuilding biotech for the AI era.

When a breakthrough is delayed, the world waits. Getting a molecule from discovery to patients, or a crop from lab to field, involves thousands of slow, manual, disconnected steps. AI has the potential to change this, compressing decades of R&D work into years. But that only happens when clean, structured scientific data and AI are built into how science gets done.

Benchling is the AI platform for biotech R&D. Scientists use Benchling to design experiments, capture structured data, and run AI agents and models directly in their workflows. Over 200,000 scientists around the world trust Benchling to power their most important work, from academic labs to Sanofi, Moderna, and more than half of the world's top 50 biopharma.

We’re building an AI scientist for our customers. We can’t do that if we haven’t built the muscle ourselves. AI fluency is the foundation we build on; it's core to how we work, and we're committed to helping every new hire integrate it into their day-to-day. As part of our interview process, you'll complete a brief AI-focused exercise or discussion so we can understand how you think about and use AI to drive impact in your role. Feel free to reference any tools, platforms, or workflows you use today.

ROLE OVERVIEW

We are seeking an Enterprise Solutions Architect with deep expertise in life science R&D and enterprise software systems to partner with Benchling's customers in driving the biotech revolution forward.

The Enterprise Solutions Architect serves as a strategic advisor and technical leader for our enterprise customers, translating their IT strategy into tailored Benchling solutions. This role encompasses guiding organizations through digital transformation, leading technical implementation projects, overseeing solution architecture, and establishing best practices and data architecture standards to ensure long-term success.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Partner with biotechnology organizations at the forefront of innovation to assess their IT landscape, understand strategic objectives, and architect solutions that enable mission-critical outcomes.

  • Lead end-to-end implementation projects from discovery through successful go-live and adoption.

  • Provide ongoing strategic guidance, best practice education, and product engagement recommendations to maximize customer value realization.

  • Collaborate with cross-functional business and technology stakeholders to gather requirements, identify opportunities, and translate business needs into technical solutions in partnership with internal engineering, product, and solutions architecture teams.

  • Coordinate with Professional Services, Product, and Customer Success teams to orchestrate complex, global enterprise deployments.

  • Support Sales and Marketing in technical deal strategy, and engage with Engineering, Product, and Solutions Architecture teams to resolve complex technical challenges.

  • Contribute to the development and refinement of global enterprise processes, product capabilities, and best practice frameworks.

  • Partner with biotechnology organizations at the forefront of innovation to assess their IT landscape, understand strategic objectives, and architect solutions that enable mission-critical outcomes.

QUALIFICATIONS

 Required

  • 5-10+ years of combined experience in biotechnology or pharmaceutical industry roles and scientific software implementation.

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Life Sciences, Information Management, or related field (advanced degree preferred).

  • Proven track record leading global implementation teams in enterprise solution design and deployment (Benchling experience strongly preferred).

  • Demonstrated ability to empathize with scientists and rapidly comprehend complex scientific concepts and workflows.

  • Exceptional communication skills across verbal, written, and presentation formats, coupled with strong organizational and project management capabilities.

  • Self-directed, adaptable professional who thrives in dynamic, fast-paced environments.

  • Comfortable operating across functions, organizational levels, and geographies with diverse stakeholder groups.

  • Willingness to travel to customer sites up to 30% based on project requirements.

Preferred

  • 5+ years of client-facing software implementation and/or consulting experience, with demonstrated success delivering enterprise-scale SaaS projects.

  • Hands-on experience implementing scientific/informatics platforms such as LIMS, ELN, MES, LES, and analytical tools including JMP, Spotfire, or Tableau.

HOW WE WORK

We offer a flexible hybrid work arrangement that prioritizes in-office collaboration. Employees are expected to be on-site 3 days per week (Monday, Tuesday, and Thursday).

#LI-Hybrid #LI-Remote

#BI-Hybrid #BI-Remote

Benchling welcomes everyone.

We believe diversity enriches our team so we hire people with a wide range of identities, backgrounds, and experiences.

We are an equal opportunity employer. That means we don’t discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. We also consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law, including but not limited to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance.

title: Consultant Digital Analytics & SEO (80 - 100%)
description:
Daten im Kopf? SEO im Blut? Dann suchen wir genau dich! Wir bieten dir die passende Stelle als Digital Analytics & SEO Consultant (w/m/x) bei Digital Leverage in Zürich. Der Starttermin ist flexibel.

Wir sind Digital Leverage, eine erfahrene SEO- & GEO-Agentur mit Sitz in Zürich und grossen Plänen. Unsere Kund:innen sind vielfältig und dynamisch – B2B, B2C, vom agilen KMU bis zum etablierten Grossunternehmen. So bekommst du spannende Einblicke in verschiedene Branchen und Unternehmen.

Unsere Kundschaft will verstehen, was digitale Sichtbarkeit – von der klassischen Suche bis zu KI-Antworten – bewirkt. Dafür brauchen wir verlässliche Daten, durchdachte Messkonzepte und Menschen, die daraus klare Handlungsempfehlungen ableiten. Hier kommst du ins Spiel.

Aufgaben

Als Digital Analytics & SEO Consultant arbeitest du an der Schnittstelle zwischen SEO/GEO und KPI-Tracking und -Reporting. In deinen Projekten übernimmst du vom ersten Moment an das Ruder. Du berätst unsere Kund:innen, entwickelst passende Messkonzepte und Dashboards und begleitest deren Umsetzung. Du hilfst ihnen, die Wirkung ihrer digitalen Aktivitäten zu verstehen und ihre Sichtbarkeit in Suchmaschinen und KI-Antworten gezielt weiterzuentwickeln.

Dabei arbeitest du eng mit unserem Team an SEO-, GEO- und Content-Spezialist:innen sowie den Marketing- und Entwicklungsteams unserer Kund:innen zusammen. Du bekommst viel Freiraum, Verantwortung und die Gelegenheit, unser Angebot im Bereich Digital Analytics aktiv mitzugestalten.

Die interne Weiterentwicklung zur/zum Lead Digital Analytics wird begrüsst und gefördert!

Zu deinen Aufgaben gehören u.a.:

  • Entwicklung von Messkonzepten, KPI-Frameworks und Tracking-Plänen entlang der Customer Journey

  • Einrichtung und Weiterentwicklung von Tracking-Lösungen mit Google Analytics 4 und Google Tag Manager unter Berücksichtigung der Consent-Anforderungen

  • Durchführung von Analytics- und Tracking-Audits sowie Qualitätssicherung und Verbesserung der Datenqualität

  • Aufbau und Betreuung von Prompt-Trackings zur Messung der Sichtbarkeit unserer Kund:innen in KI-Antworten, beispielsweise mit Peec AI oder Rankscale

  • Begleitung von Relaunch-Projekten aus Analytics- und Tracking-Perspektive

  • Analyse von Traffic, Nutzerverhalten und Conversions sowie Ableitung konkreter Optimierungsmöglichkeiten

  • Analyse der KI-Sichtbarkeit, Markennennungen und Quellenverweise im Wettbewerbsvergleich sowie Einordnung des messbaren Traffics aus KI-Plattformen

  • Erstellung und Interpretation verständlicher Dashboards (bspw. Data Studio, Adobe Analytics etc.) und Reportings, die Ergebnisse und Handlungsmöglichkeiten auf den Punkt bringen

  • Eigenständige Beratung und Betreuung unserer Kund:innen sowie Entwicklung datenbasierter Empfehlungen für ihre GEO-Strategie

  • Coaching von Teammitgliedern und externen Ansprechpartnern

Qualifikation

Wir sind grosse Fans von Menschen mit Drive und Eigeninitiative. Du hast bereits einiges an Erfahrung in den Bereichen Digital Analytics, SEO und GEO gesammelt und Freude daran, technische Zusammenhänge zu verstehen, Daten kritisch zu hinterfragen und Erkenntnisse verständlich zu vermitteln.

Du verbindest analytisches Denken mit einem guten Gespür für die Ziele unserer Kundschaft. Dabei fühlst du dich im Austausch mit externen Marketingverantwortlichen ebenso wohl wie in der Zusammenarbeit mit deinem Team. Du brennst für Daten und möchtest mitgestalten, wie Unternehmen ihre Sichtbarkeit und deren Wirkung in einer sich verändernden Suchlandschaft messen.

Dein Profil:

  • Mehrjährige Erfahrung im Bereich Digital Analytics, idealerweise in einer Agentur oder beratenden Funktion

  • Erfahrung und starkes Interesse für die Bereiche SEO und GEO

  • Sicherer Umgang mit Google Analytics 4, Google Tag Manager, Data Studio – Erfahrung mit Adobe Analytics und Matomo ist von Vorteil

  • Erfahrung in der Entwicklung von Messkonzepten sowie in der Umsetzung und Qualitätssicherung von Event- und Conversion-Tracking

  • Gutes Verständnis für Datenqualität, Consent Management und die Grenzen digitaler Erfolgsmessung

  • Fähigkeit, aus Daten konkrete Handlungsempfehlungen abzuleiten und diese überzeugend zu präsentieren

  • Grundlegende Kenntnisse in HTML und JavaScript sowie Verständnis für Data Layers und die technische Funktionsweise von Websites

  • Freude an Kundenberatung, Projektleitung und der Zusammenarbeit mit unterschiedlichen Stakeholdern

  • Ausgezeichnete Kommunikationsfähigkeit auf Deutsch und gute Englischkenntnisse, mündlich und schriftlich

  • Strukturierte, sorgfältige und selbstständige Arbeitsweise – auch wenn mehrere Projekte gleichzeitig laufen

Benefits

Du profitierst von:

  • Flache Hierarchien und kurze Entscheidungswege: Bei uns gibt es keine "Chefetage".

  • Grünes Büro direkt im Kreis 4: Profitiere von einem top ausgestatteten Büro, vielseitigen Lunch-Möglichkeiten und super Verbindungen zum HB.

  • Selbstbestimmtes Arbeiten: Tageweise Homeoffice, Gleitzeiten oder auch mal Remote Work aus dem Ausland – du gestaltest deinen Arbeitsplatz!

  • Aktive Weiterbildung: Deine Weiterentwicklung wird geschätzt und gefördert – Ehrenwort.

  • Attraktive Fringe Benefits: 13. Monatslohn plus Bonus, Pauschalspesen, langfristige Möglichkeit Firmenanteile zu erwerben und mehr!

  • Moderne Kultur: Bist du ready für offenen Feedbackaustausch, monatliche Teamevents, jährliche Workation in Europa und Lohntransparenz?

Wir haben dir viel zu bieten. Du uns auch?

Joeline Fruchi freut sich auf deine Bewerbungen inklusive CV und einem überzeugenden Motivationsschreiben auf Deutsch.

title: M365 Operations & Support Engineer (Bern/Zürich/hybrid) 60-100%
description:
Montagmorgen, 08:15 Uhr: Bei einem Kunden kann niemand mehr auf SharePoint zugreifen, zwei neue Mitarbeitende warten auf ihr Intune-Gerät und eine Postfachregel leitet seit Freitag Mails ins Leere. Alles ist irgendwie dringend und nicht alles ist gleich wichtig. Du bringst Ordnung hinein: Du erkennst, was brennt, löst selbst, was du lösen kannst, und gibst den Rest gezielt an die richtigen Specialist Engineers weiter. Unsere Kunden merken davon vor allem eines, nämlich dass es funktioniert.

Wir bei Epic Fusion sind ein AI-native Team: unkompliziert, kurze Wege, viel Gestaltungsspielraum. Wir probieren Neues aus, ganz im Sinne von «Learn it over Know it», und bauen es direkt in unsere Prozesse ein. Unseren Helpdesk verstehen wir als intelligente, agentengestützte Serviceplattform und nicht als Ticketsystem. Nicht alles funktioniert auf Anhieb, aber wir lernen schnell und bauen auf dem auf, was sich bewährt. Ein fertiges Prozesshandbuch für jede Situation gibt es bei uns nicht. Wenn du das brauchst, sind wir nicht die Richtigen. Wenn du es lieber selbst schreibst, schon.

Das gestaltest du bei uns:

  • Den Überblick behalten: Du übernimmst die Ticket-Triage im B2B-Helpdesk, setzt Prioritäten und sorgst dafür, dass jeder Case beim richtigen Menschen landet.

  • Selbst lösen: Second-Level-Anfragen rund um Microsoft 365 bearbeitest du eigenständig, vom Troubleshooting über die Konfiguration bis zur Wurzelursachenanalyse. Du willst wissen, warum etwas kaputt war, und nicht nur, dass es wieder läuft.

  • SLAs im Griff haben: Du überwachst SLAs und offene Cases und greifst ein, bevor etwas eskaliert.

  • Kunden auf Augenhöhe begleiten: Du pflegst die Kundenbeziehung proaktiv. Unsere Kunden wissen, wen sie anrufen können, und vertrauen dir.

  • Im Team spielen: Du arbeitest eng mit unseren Operations- und Workplace-Specialists zusammen und gibst Fälle so weiter, dass niemand nachfragen muss.

  • Den Helpdesk smarter machen: Was zweimal von Hand passiert, schaust du dir genauer an. Du gestaltest mit, wie AI-Agents und automatisierte Workflows Triage, Analyse und Kommunikation im Helpdesk übernehmen.


Du passt zu uns, wenn …

  • du Microsoft 365 aus der Praxis kennst und Intune, Entra ID, Exchange, Teams oder SharePoint für dich keine Fremdwörter sind. Erfahrung mit Software-Paketierung, Printix oder Azure ist ein Plus, aber kein Muss.

  • du bereits in einem Helpdesk oder IT-Operations-Umfeld gearbeitet hast und weisst, wie sich ein voller Montagmorgen anfühlt.

  • du auch unter Druck ruhig bleibst und einem gestressten Kunden in zwei Sätzen erklären kannst, was als Nächstes passiert.

  • du AI-Tools schon ausprobiert hast, weil es dich interessiert hat und nicht weil es jemand verlangt hat.

  • du auf Deutsch und Englisch souverän kommunizierst.

… und dich diese Benefits ansprechen:

  • AI ohne Limit: Auf unserer eigenen Frontier Engine arbeitest du mit den 30 führenden Frontier-Modellen (Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, Mistral, Moonshot), dazu kommt Microsoft Copilot inklusive Cowork. Ein Token-Budget gibt es nicht.

  • Weiterbildung: Du bildest dich gezielt weiter, zum Beispiel mit Microsoft-Zertifizierungen, und wächst mit uns Richtung Specialist oder Engineer.

  • Pensum, das passt: 60–100 %, je nachdem, was zu deinem Leben passt.

  • Arbeiten, wo es passt: in unseren Office-Hubs in Zürich oder Bern oder remote aus der ganzen Schweiz.

  • 6 Wochen Ferien, geschäftliche Fahrten SBB 1. Klasse und eine exzellente Pensionskassenlösung.

title: Programmatic Advertising Specialist - BENELUX
description:
Programmatic Advertising Specialist (Dutch Speaking)

Publisher Success | Amsterdam, Netherlands (Onsite) | Full Time | Permanent

About Refinery89



Refinery89 is a Dutch AdTech company headquartered in Madrid, working with premium publishers worldwide to optimize programmatic advertising performance.

Through advanced, data-driven technology, we help publishers maximize advertising revenue, improve monetization efficiency, and gain greater transparency across their advertising operations.

Our international team brings together specialists in programmatic advertising, publisher monetization, technology, and account management to deliver measurable results for our partners.

About the Role



Are you currently working in Programmatic Advertising, Ad Operations, Campaign Management, or Publisher Monetization and looking to take the next step in your career?

We're looking for a Dutch-speaking Programmatic Advertising Specialist to join our Publisher Success team in Amsterdam.

This opportunity is ideal for someone with a solid understanding of digital advertising who wants to move beyond campaign execution and take on a more strategic, publisher-facing role.

You don't need previous Account Management experience. We're particularly interested in candidates who understand the programmatic advertising ecosystem, enjoy analyzing performance, solving technical challenges, and communicating with clients.

You'll work directly with Dutch publishers, helping them optimize their advertising performance, maximize revenue, and develop long-term partnerships with Refinery89.

You'll collaborate closely with our Technical Account Managers, AdTech specialists, Product, and Sales teams to deliver the best possible experience for our publishing partners.

Key Responsibilities



Publisher Relationship Management

  • Build and maintain strong relationships with publishers in the Netherlands.
  • Serve as a primary point of contact for publisher inquiries, performance discussions, and ongoing support.
  • Develop a deep understanding of each publisher's business needs and monetization objectives.
  • Build trust through proactive communication, responsiveness, and problem-solving.


Programmatic Performance & Revenue Optimization

  • Monitor and analyze advertising performance, including revenue, eCPM, fill rates, and other relevant programmatic metrics.
  • Identify opportunities to improve publisher monetization and overall advertising performance.
  • Translate advertising data into clear insights and actionable recommendations.
  • Collaborate with technical specialists to implement and evaluate optimization initiatives.


Technical Coordination & Troubleshooting

  • Help publishers identify and resolve advertising-related issues.
  • Work closely with internal AdTech and Technical Account Management teams to investigate technical challenges.
  • Coordinate solutions and ensure publishers receive timely updates.
  • Develop a strong understanding of Refinery89's advertising technology and monetization solutions.


Strategic Growth & Publisher Success

  • Identify opportunities to grow existing publisher accounts.
  • Support publisher performance reviews and strategic discussions.
  • Share insights about market trends, advertising technologies, and monetization opportunities.
  • Contribute to long-term publisher satisfaction, retention, and growth.


Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Work closely with Publisher Sales, Technical Account Managers, AdTech, Product, and Finance teams.
  • Communicate publisher feedback and market insights internally.
  • Help improve processes, workflows, and the overall publisher experience.


What We're Looking For



Must-Have Qualifications

  • Native-level Dutch proficiency, with professional working proficiency in English.
  • 1 to 3 years of experience in programmatic advertising, AdTech, digital advertising, campaign management, or publisher operations.
  • Familiarity with the programmatic advertising ecosystem, including technologies such as Google Ad Manager, SSPs, DSPs, or ad exchanges.
  • Comfortable working with advertising performance data, reports, and dashboards.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent communication skills and the ability to explain technical concepts clearly.
  • Proactive, organized, and comfortable working in a fast-paced environment.
  • Interest in working directly with publishers and developing long-term business relationships.


Nice to Have

  • Experience with Google Ad Manager or other advertising platforms.
  • Knowledge of header bidding, Prebid.js, or publisher monetization strategies.
  • Previous experience working with publishers, media owners, or advertising technology companies.
  • Experience in campaign optimization, yield management, or programmatic trading.
  • Previous client-facing or Account Management experience.


Previous Account Management experience is NOT required.

Who Should Apply?



We encourage applications from professionals currently working in roles such as:

  • Programmatic Advertising Specialist
  • Programmatic Trader
  • Ad Operations Specialist
  • Campaign Manager (Programmatic)
  • Publisher Operations Specialist
  • Yield Optimization Specialist
  • Digital Advertising Specialist
  • Technical Account Specialist (AdTech)


If you have a technical understanding of digital advertising and want to develop your career in publisher relationship management, we'd love to hear from you.

Why Join Refinery89?

  • Work at a growing international AdTech company with Dutch roots.
  • Develop expertise in publisher monetization and programmatic advertising.
  • Transition into a more strategic, client-facing position while building on your existing technical knowledge.
  • Collaborate with experienced AdTech professionals across multiple departments.
  • Gain exposure to premium publishers and advanced advertising technologies.
  • Build your career in a dynamic and rapidly evolving industry.


Interview Process



Our recruitment process consists of four stages:

  1. Initial Screening: Introductory call with our Talent Acquisition team.
  2. First Interview: Video interview with members of the Publisher Success team.
  3. Second Interview: Interview with the Hiring Manager and/or senior stakeholders.
  4. Final Interview: In-person meeting with the Hiring Manager and key team members (location to be confirmed).


Ready to Take the Next Step?



Whether you're currently managing advertising campaigns, optimizing programmatic performance, or supporting publisher monetization, this could be your opportunity to take on greater responsibility and develop your career in AdTech.

Apply today and join Refinery89's Publisher Success team in Amsterdam.

title: Model-Based Systems Engineer
description:
About Us

QuantWare is building the world’s most powerful quantum processors to solve humanity's greatest challenges. We do this with our unique VIO™ technology, the only QPU architecture that breaks the hardware barriers that have held quantum computing back, unlocking the path to MegaQubit quantum processors.

With VIO, we are paving the way for the hyper-scale quantum computers that will change the world. And delivering on that vision demands people who don’t shy away from tackling the hardest challenges of our time. That’s where you come in!

Our Systems Integration Team is seeking a Model-Based Systems Engineer to build the tools and framework we use to design the systems that operate our VIO and QPU technology. This role is focused on establishing QuantWare’s MBSE methodology and turning knowledge from cryogenics, wiring, control electronics and software into a single, executable system model. You will define how we model our systems and build the libraries, analyses and integrations that make the model useful day to day. Working closely with processor, hardware and software teams, you will play an important role in enabling the design of the large-scale quantum computers built around VIO-powered QPUs.

What are you going to do?

  • Define and own QuantWare’s MBSE methodology, modelling conventions and architecture framework for quantum computing systems, covering the quantum processor, cryostat, signal chain, control and readout electronics, and software stack.

  • Select, set up and maintain the MBSE toolchain (e.g. SysML v2, Capella or Cameo), including version control, model reviews and integration with existing engineering tools.

  • Build reusable model libraries for key subsystems, including QPU interfaces, cryogenic wiring and attenuation, microwave signal paths, and control electronics.

  • Develop automated analyses on top of the model, such as heat-load, signal-integrity and noise budgets, channel counts, scalability, and full-system metrics such as power consumption as qubit counts grow.

  • Establish requirements traceability from customer and system-level requirements down to component specifications and verification tests.

  • Connect the system model to simulation and measurement data, creating a digital thread between design and test.

  • Support system architecture and trade studies for new VIO and QPU generations and customer system integrations.

  • Drive adoption across the company, training and supporting engineers in using the models and tools in their day-to-day work.

Qualifications

Core Requirements:

  • BSc. or MSc. in systems engineering, electrical engineering, physics, mechanical engineering or a related field.

  • 3+ years of hands-on MBSE experience, including building or extending a modelling framework rather than only using existing ones.

  • Hands on experience with hardware system models that encompass multiple subsystems with differing requirements and interfaces.

  • Strong working knowledge of SysML (v1 and/or v2) and at least one MBSE tool, such as Cameo, Capella or equivalent.

  • Proficiency in Python for model automation, analysis and tool integration via APIs.

  • A solid track record in requirements engineering and verification of complex, multidisciplinary hardware systems.

  • Strong organisational and communication skills. You thrive in a cross-disciplinary environment and are comfortable taking ownership from day one.

Bonus Points

  • Experience with cryogenic, RF/microwave or precision instrumentation systems, or direct experience with superconducting quantum hardware.

  • Background in high-tech, semiconductor, aerospace or scientific instrumentation industries.

  • Experience introducing MBSE into an organisation and driving its adoption.

  • Familiarity with SysML v2 APIs, digital thread concepts or co-simulation (e.g. FMI), as well as systems engineering standards such as ISO/IEC 15288.

Don't tick every box? Apply anyway! Research shows women often self-select out if they don't meet every requirement. Here's our take: nobody ticks every box. This is a description of our ideal candidate, not a filter. If most resonates and you're keen to learn the gaps, apply. We hire for trajectory, not perfection.

What We Offer:

At QuantWare, you’ll be part of a high-performing team of world-class experts in an ambitious, fast-moving environment. From day one, you’ll have the trust, tools, and support to do your best work. Here’s what you can expect:

Competitive salary - A salary that reflects the impact and importance of the role (and of course 8% holiday allowance)

Pension that’s built to last - A generous and future-proof pension plan that includes partner and dependent coverage.

Flexibility built on trust - We focus on outcomes. Work flexibly, in a hybrid setup, with an open vacation policy that lets you manage your time

Personal growth - We invest in your L&D, with a budget available to each team member, dependent on their individual ambitions, development needs, and performance

A connected team - We make space to celebrate wins together, with team events, offsites, and spontaneous moments that bring us closer

Diversity & Inclusion at QuantWare

We’re an ambitious company, not only for our goals but also to become an even more diverse and inclusive team. We know great candidates don't always follow a straight path, and we value diverse experience, perspectives, and ways of thinking. We know this helps us make better decisions, drives more innovation, and strengthens our culture.

As part of our recruitment process, candidates may be required to undergo pre-employment screening.

We're looking for a GTM Engineer, Marketing (f/m/d) to join our team in Munich, Germany.

You won’t just use AI tools. You’ll help build the agentic layer that supports our GTM efforts: workflows and agents that take repeatable work off channel owners’ plates and make marketing measurably better at creating demand and influencing pipeline. Support channel owners with an agentic layer

Account Executive

VLogic Systems is a $12M ARR, private equity-backed SaaS company providing mission-critical Facility Management software across a number of industries including government, healthcare, and education. title: Procurement Advisory Services (contract)
description:
Who We Are

Hi, we're DuckDuckGo, the online protection company and remote-first team of 400+ on a mission to raise the standard of trust online. Founded in 2008 and profitable since 2014, annual revenue now exceeds $100m USD and millions use our browser on Mac, Windows, iOS, and Android, our search engine, and the DuckDuckGo subscription. We also offer private, useful, and optional AI, including Duck.ai, which lets you chat privately with ChatGPT, Claude, and other AIs, all in one place.

Partnerships Team

The Partnerships team sources, negotiates, and manages external relationships behind DuckDuckGo's products, from AI model and cloud infrastructure providers to distribution, content, and monetization partners. Alongside that work, the team also handles a steady stream of vendor deals for the software, tooling, and service contracts that keeps the company running.

Our Need

We are seeking a well-established, independent Procurement Advisor Practice to advise the partnerships team in DuckDuckGo's vendor selection, procurement and negotiations. Our procurement efforts cover a broad set of vendors including collaboration tools, AI services, SaaS, analytics and data tools, developer tooling, and professional services. We are seeking a procurement advisory practice that will provide our team with counsel on needs scoping, vendor identification, vendor conversations, price negotiations strategies and benchmarks, and guidance on proposed terms. DuckDuckGo remains responsible for our internal processes and approvals, and for signing vendor contracts.

Advisory Practice Profile

  • 10+ years advisory practice in procurement, strategic sourcing, or vendor management, with a focus on software and SaaS. Your practice has provided direction on hundreds of contracts and has deep enough experience to provide clients with guidance on where the leverage usually is.

  • Your practice has a well-established approach to commercial and contractual details -- including deep experience in providing guidance on order forms, MSAs, and DPAs terms, a time-tested methodology for vendor comparison, and proven track record of working across a client organization including with legal, security, finance, product, engineering.

  • Your practice has sufficient capacity to advise many small deals in parallel, each with a different internal owner.

  • Your practice has deep experience in providing deal advisory across a broad set of vendors: collaboration, recruiting, analytics, developer tooling, data and research subscriptions, professional services.

  • Your practice has a proven track record of building trust quickly with client teams, providing clear client communications, and working asynchronously across multiple time zones in North America and Europe.

  • Your practice cares about privacy and has experience in navigating data handling and security issues with clients and vendors.

  • Your practice is an established business: an operating entity or registered sole proprietorship with other current clients, its own professional liability insurance, and client references available on request.

  • Your practice is located in the US.

Engagement Details

We expect the scope of work to cover an estimated 3 to 5 deals per month (estimated approximately 15-20 hours per week) compensated by a fixed rate, with pricing for additional volume set out in the statement of work, starting with an initial six-month term with the option to extend. This is a business-to-business services engagement, not employment. Your practice will deliver advisory services remotely on its own schedule with working sessions scheduled by mutual agreement. Your practice will use its own equipment, tools, and methods. DuckDuckGo will provide the deal information and access to internal deal owners needed for each engagement, and limited system access where a specific deal requires it.

As an independent consultant, your practice is responsible for its own taxes, insurance, and business expenses, and invoices DuckDuckGo monthly under the statement of work.

How to Submit a Proposal

Please send a short proposal to bdhiring@duckduckgo.com with the subject line of “Procurement Advisory Services“ covering your practice's background and structure, representative clients and references, your proposed approach and the personnel who would perform the work, and your fee proposal for the scope above.

Nondiscrimination Policy

DuckDuckGo evaluates proposals without discrimination on the basis of race, color, ethnicity, caste, religion, age, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by our policies or federal, state, or local laws.

We want to ensure that our selection process is accessible. If you need reasonable accommodation for any part of the proposal process because of a medical condition or disability, please send an email to bdhiring@duckduckgo.com to let us know the nature of your request.

Please note that:

  • Your practice will be subject to DuckDuckGo's standard vendor due diligence, including privacy and security review, and must confirm that any personnel assigned to the engagement have passed a background check conducted by your practice.

  • By submitting a proposal, you confirm that all information submitted is accurate and complete. You further acknowledge that providing false or fraudulent information is cause for rejection of the proposal or immediate termination of the engagement.

DISCLOSURE STATEMENT: USE OF AI IN VENDOR SELECTION

As part of our commitment to enhancing our vendor evaluation process, we use artificial intelligence (“AI”) tools to help review and summarize proposals, flag potentially fraudulent submissions, and compare proposals against our evaluation criteria. All final selection decisions are made by DuckDuckGo personnel. Information you submit will be handled in accordance with our privacy policies. If you have questions, contact bdhiring@duckduckgo.com. Thank you for your interest in working with DuckDuckGo!

Nivoda is a rapidly scaling global B2B diamond and gemstone marketplace connecting jewellery retailers with competitive, high-quality suppliers worldwide. Processing $300M+ in annual transactions and operating across multiple regions, Nivoda is transforming a $350B industry that has historically been slow to modernise.

Our platform gives businesses of all sizes, from independent jewellers to major retail chains access to the world's best diamond and gemstone inventory, without the traditional barriers of capital, geography, or information asymmetry.

Our Mission 🎯

Diamond and gemstone trading has long been plagued by inefficiency, opacity, and exclusivity. Nivoda was built to change that - to democratise access and empower every business, regardless of size or location, to buy and sell with confidence. Independent jewellers are at the heart of this mission. They deserve the same access to quality, pricing, and selection as the biggest players in the industry. That's exactly what we give them.

Our Sales team is the engine that brings Nivoda's mission to life. About the Role 🤔

You are the front of the machine: you take inbound leads and hunt outbound prospects, qualify them fast, and get a demo on the AE's calendar. Your job ends when the demo is booked and confirmed — everything before that moment is yours.

This is a high-velocity, transactional sales role. Think SaaS SDR playbook: tight cadences, high activity volume, sharp qualification, relentless follow-up. What do we need from you? 💪

  • A killer on the phone and crisp in writing; comfortable with 60–80+ meaningful touches a day.

  • Process-driven: you live in cadences and CRM hygiene rather than fighting them.

  • Coachable and resilient — you treat "no" as data and keep the energy up on day 20 of the month, not just day 1.

  • Native or professional proficiency in English and German is required for this role.

  • Jewellery knowledge not required; hunger and rigour are.

If after reading this job description you believe this is not the best fit for you, we'd encourage you to join our Nivoda Talent Pool so we can keep you in mind as new roles open up.

ABOUT QUINCE

Quince is a destination for builders, creators, innovators, and operators who want to come together and challenge the status quo. Our mission is simple: make really high quality essentials for really low prices, fairly and sustainably. We deliver on that mission through a unique manufacturer-to-consumer (M2C) model eliminating the layers of traditional retail that add cost and result in consumers paying more than they need to. We find, build relationships with, and work directly with the manufacturing partners behind some of the world’s finest products. From there, our teams design smart, efficient operational processes and build and deploy proprietary technology, AI, and analytics to help us scale fast.

What began with a small assortment of elevated basics has quickly grown into a cross-category brand spanning apparel, accessories, home goods, and more. Today, tens of millions of people across a growing number of countries come – and return – to Quince because they trust us to deliver.

OUR CULTURE

Quince is a culture built for builders by builders. Our way of working starts with a blank sheet of paper. We question conventional thinking, use technology and data to uncover new opportunities, and move quickly to turn ideas into reality. We aren’t interested in replicating how others do retail. We’re building a better way – at a speed and scale unlike anything that’s been done before.

  • We dream big and chase the hard problems others shy away from. Rejecting long-held assumptions is part of our company's DNA. Where conventional wisdom says you have to choose – soft or durable, speed or rigor, quality or price – we ask why that trade-off has to exist in the first place.
  • Our pace is fast and the bar is high because our customers expect a lot from us and we refuse to let them down. We believe the best results come from challenging ourselves, learning from one another, and building on each other's strengths.
  • Here, responsibility is not determined by role, tenure, or seniority. Every team member - no matter their level - has the opportunity to drive our business and shape our trajectory.

If you’re someone who likes to imagine new possibilities and build better systems rather than plug-in to outdated ones, Quince is the place for you.

THE ROLE

Enterprise Account Executive

This role requires a proactive and strategic approach to business development, relationship management, and ability to operate in a fast-paced dynamic start up environment.
