title: AI-ready Solutions Architect - Workplace & Security
description:
Alle wollen Copilot und AI-Agents. Aber ist das Fundament überhaupt bereit dafür?

Wer Copilot auf einem chaotischen Tenant ausrollt, liefert seinen Mitarbeitenden einen sehr schnellen Weg zu Daten, die sie nie sehen sollten. Plötzlich findet jemand die Lohnliste der Geschäftsleitung oder den Entwurf zur Reorganisation. Du sorgst dafür, dass das nicht passiert: Du machst Workplace- und Cloud-Umgebungen von Schweizer Unternehmen bereit für AI, sicher und sauber aufgesetzt, hands-on und mit eigener Handschrift.

Wir bei Epic Fusion sind ein AI-native Team: unkompliziert, kurze Wege, viel Gestaltungsspielraum. Wir probieren Neues aus, ganz im Sinne von «Learn it over Know it», und bauen es direkt in unsere Prozesse ein. Nicht alles funktioniert auf Anhieb, aber wir lernen schnell und bauen auf dem auf, was sich bewährt. Ein fertiges Prozesshandbuch für jede Situation gibt es bei uns nicht. Wenn du das brauchst, sind wir nicht die Richtigen. Wenn du es lieber selbst schreibst, schon.

Das gestaltest du bei uns:

  • Fundament legen: Du entwirfst Zielarchitekturen für Modern Workplaces mit Intune, Entra ID, Defender, Windows 365 und Azure Virtual Desktop.

  • AI-ready machen: Du räumst Identitäten, Berechtigungen und Datenklassifizierung auf, damit Copilot und Agents nur sehen, was sie sehen dürfen.

  • Absichern: Du entwickelst Security- und Governance-Konzepte mit Defender, Purview und Agent 365.

  • Automatisieren: Was zweimal von Hand passiert, löst du mit Graph API, PowerShell oder Infrastructure as Code.

  • Richtung geben: Du analysierst Kundenumgebungen, setzt klare Prioritäten und erklärst sie so, dass Technik und Management wissen, was als Nächstes passiert. Neue Microsoft- und AI-Features testest du, bevor sie beim Kunden ankommen.


Du passt zu uns, wenn …

  • du Intune, Entra ID und M365 konfigurieren kannst und auch erklären kannst, warum etwas so sein muss. Azure und Defender sind dir nicht fremd.

  • du mehrere Jahre im Microsoft-Cloud- oder Security-Umfeld gearbeitet hast und weisst, wie Tenants in der Realität aussehen.

  • du ein Studium an einer FH oder HF abgeschlossen hast oder auf anderem Weg ein Niveau erreicht hast, das sich damit messen kann.

  • du einem CIO in fünf Minuten erklären kannst, warum sein Copilot-Rollout noch warten muss, und er sich danach bei dir bedankt.

  • du Copilot, Agents oder Purview schon ausprobiert hast, weil es dich interessiert hat und nicht weil es jemand verlangt hat.

  • du auf Deutsch und Englisch souverän kommunizierst.

.. und dich diese Benefits ansprechen:

  • AI ohne Limit: Auf unserer eigenen Frontier Engine arbeitest du mit den 30 führenden Frontier-Modellen (Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, Mistral, Moonshot), dazu kommt Microsoft Copilot inklusive Cowork. Ein Token-Budget gibt es nicht.

  • Weiterbildung: Du bildest dich gezielt weiter und besuchst internationale Konferenzen, um früh zu sehen, was als Nächstes kommt.

  • Arbeiten, wo es passt: in unseren Office-Hubs in Zürich oder Bern oder remote aus der ganzen Schweiz.

  • 6 Wochen Ferien, geschäftliche Fahrten SBB 1. Klasse und eine exzellente Pensionskassenlösung.

title: Technical Oversight - Processing
description:
About Pylon

America’s $13T mortgage market is one of the most important financial systems in the world. It underwrites the middle class and is the mechanism through which millions of families build wealth. But while every other financial instrument has been simplified to an API call, mortgages are still assembled by hand.

We started from zero and created the first vertically integrated mortgage platform that turns origination into a single API.

Publicly traded companies and the country’s largest originators are already building on Pylon. Revenue is compounding monthly. We’re backed by Peter Thiel, Conversion Capital, QED, Citi, Fifth Wall, and the founders of Ramp, Blend, and Mercury.

Working at Pylon isn’t for those seeking comfort. The people who thrive here have high agency, strong opinions, and a track record of delivering outcomes without direction. Many of us are former founders. We move quickly, challenge each other directly, and take full ownership of results. It’s hard work, but it will be worth it.

Join us in building America’s mortgage rails.

About the Role

We’re seeking a Technical Oversight - Processing with deep mortgage operations experience and strong independent judgment. This is not a traditional customer support or relationship-only role. You will act as a senior operational partner to our originating customers, owning issue resolution end-to-end and ensuring loans move cleanly, compliantly, and predictably through the lifecycle.

You will work directly with customers while collaborating closely with underwriting, processing, product, and engineering to reduce errors, prevent rework, and improve system-driven workflows. This role is ideal for someone who has worked inside the loan file, understands where mortgages break, and is motivated to help build scalable, automated systems that eliminate those failures over time.

We are not a traditional mortgage lender. If you’re excited about operating with rigor today while helping design the future of automated mortgage infrastructure, this role is for you.

Key Responsibilities

Client & Origination Ownership

  • Act as a operational point of contact for originating customers, owning issue resolution from identification through closure

  • Guide customers through the full loan lifecycle, providing clear, accurate direction on requirements, timelines, disclosures and next steps

  • Own the operational health of assigned loans end-to-end, ensuring files progress on schedule and close on time by proactively identifying blockers, driving resolution, and coordinating across internal teams and customers.

  • Proactively manage customer expectations to reduce inbound escalations and uncertainty

Operational Judgment & Risk Prevention

  • Independently evaluate loan scenarios to identify potential structural, disclosure, or compliance risks before they escalate

  • Catch missing, inconsistent, or incorrect inputs that could lead to redisclosures, delays, or downstream rework

  • Provide firm, professional guidance to customers when corrections or process adherence are required

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Partner closely with underwriting, processing, and closing teams to ensure clean handoffs and aligned execution

  • Serve as a trusted escalation point, reducing leadership involvement by resolving complex or high-stakes issues directly

  • Coordinate with third-party vendors to ensure issues are addressed efficiently, quickly and accurately

Systems & Product Feedback

  • Identify recurring patterns, edge cases, and workflow gaps that impact loan quality or customer experience

  • Collaborate with Product and Engineering to help define requirements, guardrails, and operational acceptance criteria

  • Contribute real-world mortgage insight to improve automation, tooling, and system-driven decisioning

Documentation & Quality

  • Maintain clear, accurate documentation of customer interactions, decisions, and follow-ups

  • Ensure customer-facing communication aligns with regulatory requirements, internal standards, and operational best practices

Qualifications

  • 7+ years of mortgage industry experience, with hands-on roles in processing, underwriting, or a similar operational function

  • Direct experience working loans from application through CTC and closing

  • Hands-on experience with mortgage disclosures, including preparing, reviewing, or validating LEs and CDs, with a strong working knowledge of TRID timing, tolerance categories, and re-disclosure triggers.

  • Ability to independently sanity-check loan structure, including LTV, product eligibility, and basic compliance considerations

  • Prior experience serving as an escalation point for brokers, borrowers, or loan officers

  • Comfortable operating in fast-moving, ambiguous environments where processes are still being built

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain complex mortgage concepts clearly and confidently

  • High attention to detail paired with strong problem-solving instincts and sound judgment

What This Role Is Not

  • This is not a call-center or script-based customer support role

  • This is not a traditional CSM focused only on relationship management

  • This is not a sales or loan officer role — there are no commissions or volume-based incentives

  • This role requires independent mortgage judgment, ownership, and accountability

Benefits

Ownership: Meaningful early-stage equity in Pylon
Healthcare: Top-tier medical, vision & dental with support for dependents
401(k): Ability to save for your future
Flexible Time Off: Be on when you’re on and off when you’re off
Hardware Allowance: $2,000 to fix up your workspace
Annual Off-sites: Fully paid for team off-sites in beautiful corners of the world
At-cost Mortgages: We’ll help you finance your next home when you’re ready

(Flexible, Paid Workshops + Upside)

About CourseCareers

CourseCareers is an online education platform that helps people launch new careers without a college degree or prior experience.

We partner with industry professionals to create job-focused courses that teach practical, employer-aligned skills across technology, business, and the skilled trades. Our students are career changers looking for realistic, entry-level roles — and coaching helps bridge the gap between coursework and landing the job.

About the Role

We’re looking for a part-time Architectural Drafting Career Coach to support students through live workshops and optional 1:1 coaching.

This is not a traditional employment role and not a guaranteed-income position. It’s a flexible, paid opportunity best suited for drafting professionals who enjoy mentoring, teaching, and helping others break into the field — with upside if students choose to work with you.

How This Role Actually Works

  • You host a live, one-hour workshop (seminar-style) for students

  • You are paid $50 per workshop, plus any private coaching business you acquire

  • You may receive exclusive coaching opportunities based on performance and engagement

  • Workshops are used to provide value, answer questions, and showcase your expertise

There is no requirement to convert students — workshops are paid regardless — but conversion is where the upside comes from.

Responsibilities

  • Host a live, one-hour workshop on a monthly basis

  • Answer student questions about architectural drafting careers and the job search

  • Discuss tools, workflows, and expectations in real drafting environments

  • Interest in mentoring and helping career changers

  • Availability at least three evenings per week, ideally Tuesday–Thursday

Ideal Fit

This role is a great fit if you:

  • Enjoy teaching and mentoring

  • Want flexible, side income

  • Like the idea of being paid to teach — with optional upside

  • Don’t need guaranteed hours or full-time income

Compensation

  • $50 per one-hour workshop (One per month guaranteed)

  • Unlimited upside from 1:1 coaching sessions you convert

  • No caps, no quotas, no minimums

description:
Tooling Engineer - Remote Karachi | Islamabad
Job Description:

We're hiring a Tooling Engineer (Night Shift)

About the Company:

A leading engineering consulting company serving North American clients in the automotive industry. Our clients are automotive suppliers that manufacture sheet metal stamped and assembled components for major vehicle manufacturers such as Honda, Ford, Toyota, and others.

Job Overview

We are seeking a skilled and detail-oriented Tooling Engineer to join our team. The ideal candidate will be responsible for the design, development, and improvement of progressive stamping dies, welding and fabrication fixtures, assembly jigs, checking fixtures, and related production tooling for automotive and heavy manufacturing applications. This role requires strong 3D CAD capability, practical knowledge of tooling and manufacturing processes, GD&T, and problem-solving abilities, along with strong written and verbal communication skills in English to collaborate with cross-functional teams and support our North American-based clients.

Key Responsibilities:

1. Stamping Tooling - Automotive:

  • Develop progressive stamping strip layouts for automotive sheet-metal components, considering part geometry, forming requirements, material flow, and production feasibility.
  • Plan station sequencing, nesting, material utilization, carrier strips, scrap webs, pilot positioning, and progression through cutting and forming operations.
  • Perform basic engineering calculations including tonnage, cutting and forming forces, center of pressure, and die balance.
  • Design and detail punches, die blocks, strippers, pads, guides, pilots, retainers, and other progressive die components.
  • Support die tryout and troubleshooting activities, including spring-back correction, clearance adjustments, dimensional improvements, and production-related tooling issues.

2. Welding & Assembly Tooling - Automotive:

  • Design spot and MIG welding fixtures, assembly jigs, checking fixtures, and gauges for stamped automotive components and assemblies.
  • Develop robust locating schemes using component datums, RPS principles, net pads, locating pins, and pin-and-slot arrangements.Design mechanical and pneumatic locating and clamping systems while considering part loading and unloading, weld gun access, weld sequence, operator ergonomics, and maintainability.
  • Apply GD&T and dimensional requirements to ensure repeatable part location,
  • orientation, and assembly accuracy.
  • Support fixture tryout, buy-off, first-article inspection, dimensional validation, and required design modifications.

3. Fabrication & Machining Tooling - Heavy Machinery:

  • Design weld fixtures, assembly jigs, and machining fixtures for large fabricated structures such as frames, booms, buckets, tanks, and agricultural implements.
  • Develop rigid tooling solutions for large and heavy weldments while considering welding distortion, pre-camber, weld sequence, thermal effects, and dimensional stability.
  • Incorporate positioners, crane access, lifting and handling requirements, operator access, and safe loading and unloading into tooling designs.
  • Develop practical, modular, and adjustable tooling for high-mix, low-volume fabrication environments.

4. Tooling Design & Documentation:

  • Develop complete 3D CAD models and 2D manufacturing drawings for dies, fixtures, jigs, gauges, and related tooling components.
  • Apply GD&T, fits, tolerances, and basic tolerance stack-up principles to achievedimensional accuracy and repeatability.
  • Select appropriate standard tooling components, locating devices, clamps, cylinders, fasteners, and commercially available components where applicable.
  • Maintain accurate tooling documentation and incorporate revisions based try out, manufacturing, quality, and production feedback.

5. Tooling Optimization & Continuous Improvement:

  • Review existing tooling and identify opportunities to improve cycle time, ergonomics, accessibility, reliability, maintainability, quality, and manufacturing cost.
  • Troubleshoot tooling-related production and dimensional issues, identify root causes, and develop practical corrective actions.
  • Support tooling standardization, cost-reduction, and continuous improvement initiatives across manufacturing operations.

6. Cross-Functional Collaboration & Project Support:

  • Work closely with manufacturing, production, quality, maintenance, machining, welding, tool rooms, and other engineering teams throughout tooling design, tryout, and implementation.
  • Communicate tooling concepts, technical requirements, design changes, and project status clearly to internal and external stakeholders.
  • Manage multiple tooling projects and design revisions simultaneously while meeting deadlines and maintaining a high standard of work.

Qualification & Required Competencies:

  • Education: DAE in Mechanical or Tool & Die Making from a recognized board; or B.Tech / BS / BE/ BSc in Mechanical, Manufacturing, Industrial, Mechatronics Engineering, or a related discipline.
  • Experience: 2-4 years of relevant experience in tooling design, fixture design, die design, fabrication, automotive manufacturing, or heavy machinery.

Technical Skills:

  • Proficiency in 3D CAD software such as SolidWorks, Creo, CATIA, and Fusion 360.
  • Strong understanding of engineering drawings, GD&T, fits, tolerances, and basic
  • tolerance stack-up.
  • Good knowledge of progressive stamping, sheet-metal forming, welding, machining, and fabrication processes.
  • Practical understanding of fixture locating and clamping principles, RPS/datums,
  • progressive die components, and tooling design fundamentals.
  • Familiarity with pneumatic clamping systems, standard tooling components, and tooling tryout or buy-off activities is preferred.
  • Problem-Solving and Analytical Skills: Ability to troubleshoot tooling, dimensional, and production issues and develop practical, manufacturable solutions.
  • Communication and Teamwork: Strong written and verbal communication skills in English to collaborate with cross-functional teams and communicate technical information clearly.
  • Project Management: Ability to manage multiple tooling projects and design revisions while meeting deadlines and maintaining a high standard of work.

Additional Information:

  • Working Hours: 4:00 PM to 1:00 AM PKT (Monday to Friday) to support our North American-based clients.

title: Music & Sound Annotation Expert
description:
Role Title: Music & Sound Annotation Expert

Role Type: Contractor

Location: Remote

micro1 is engaging Music & Sound Annotation Experts to contribute to a customer's project at the forefront of music and audio technology.

Your ears are the ground truth. You'll listen to short field recordings and document exactly what's audible — instruments, tempo, key, background sounds, crowd reactions — through a structured web platform built for this project. Later phases involve grading AI model answers against what you actually heard.

What you'll do

  1. Listen to 30–90 second field recordings (headphones, your own quiet workspace) and complete structured annotations: which instruments are present, tempo and key, timestamps of background events (traffic, sirens, applause), scene details
  2. Compare paired recordings of the same song captured at different locations and judge what stayed the same and what changed
  3. In later phases: review AI model descriptions of clips and mark what's correct, wrong, or invented, with a brief written explanation
  4. Attend a paid onboarding/calibration session and a short weekly sync

Who we're looking for (any of these backgrounds)

  1. Working or gigging musicians, session players, producers, or mixing engineers
  2. Music educators, ear-training instructors, band/choir directors, conservatory students or graduates
  3. Location sound recordists, sound designers, foley artists, or podcast/documentary audio editors

Requirements

  1. 3+ years of hands-on music or audio experience
  2. Strong analytical listening: you can pick individual instruments out of a busy, noisy, real-world mix — not just studio recordings
  3. Can identify tempo (within a few BPM) and musical key (relative pitch with a reference is fine)
  4. Comfortable with detail-oriented, repetitive annotation work in a web platform — dropdowns, timestamps, short structured notes
  5. Clear written English for brief, evidence-based notes (e.g., "accordion enters around 0:12")

title: Remote Customer Service Representative - Independent Contractor
description:
Company Description

ShyftOff is a flexible work platform that connects independent customer service professionals with leading brands across the U.S. With 26,000+ agents and growing, we're changing how people work by giving them more freedom, flexibility, and control over their earning potential.

Our platform offers 100% remote customer service opportunities, flexible scheduling in 30-minute increments, competitive compensation, and weekly payments. Whether you're looking for supplemental income or more consistent opportunities, ShyftOff makes it easy to find work that fits your life.

Work from home. Choose your hours. Earn on your terms.

Opportunity Description

ShyftOff connects independent customer service professionals with opportunities to support leading brands across industries like healthcare, financial services, insurance, retail, and technology.

As an independent agent on the ShyftOff platform, you'll have opportunities to help customers answer questions, resolve issues, and deliver exceptional service, all from the comfort of your home.

Compensation: $14–$20 per hour, depending on the program and applicable compensation structure.

Why Join ShyftOff?

  • Choose your own schedule: Select available shifts in 30-minute increments. Accept opportunities that fit your life, with no minimum hour commitments.
  • 100% remote: Provide customer service from home, without a commute or traditional office schedule.
  • Competitive earnings: Access opportunities with competitive, program-specific compensation rates disclosed before you commit.
  • Weekly payments: Get paid weekly for completed services, subject to program terms.
  • Multiple opportunities: Explore customer service programs across a variety of industries based on your qualifications and availability.
  • Priority Boarding: Top-performing, reliable agents receive priority access to available shifts, helping maximize their earning opportunities.
  • Work on your terms: Operate as a 1099 independent contractor with the freedom to choose which opportunities you accept.

Qualifications

We're looking for dependable, customer-focused independent professionals who take pride in delivering great service.

  • 3+ years of customer service experience preferred.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Strong problem-solving abilities, empathy, and active listening skills.
  • Ability to fulfill accepted service commitments and meet client quality standards.
  • Comfortable navigating multiple computer systems and learning new technology.
  • Modern computer, USB headset, and reliable hard-wired internet connection (25 Mbps minimum).
  • Quiet, professional workspace suitable for customer calls.
  • Ability to complete program-specific qualifications, certifications, and onboarding requirements.

Location: Remote, United States only. Eligibility is limited to ShyftOff-approved states.

How to Get Started

  1. Sign up: Create your free ShyftOff account, complete your application, and submit your video interview.
  2. Explore opportunities: Review available programs, compensation rates, and qualification requirements to find the right fit.
  3. Get qualified: Complete any required program-specific certifications or onboarding.
  4. Choose your shifts: Select available 30-minute shifts that work for your schedule.
  5. Get paid weekly: Earn money by delivering great customer service.

Ready to Get Started?

Join 26,000+ agents who have discovered a more flexible way to work.

Your schedule. Your opportunities. Your success.

Sign up today at https://app.shyftoff.com/r/QPFQWH

Independent Contractor Disclosure: ShyftOff provides opportunities for independent contractors, not traditional employment. Agents choose whether to accept available opportunities and are responsible for their own taxes, equipment, and business expenses. Compensation, qualifications, and available hours vary by program and are not guaranteed. There is no fee to join ShyftOff. When you opt into a specific client program, you pay for that program's non-refundable background check ($40 for most programs; $199 for the Financial Services program). Program-specific certification and onboarding requirements are explained in the ShyftOff app.
